@roblox/enum/VelocityConstraintMode.Line.documentation:
The velocity component in the direction of the line is constrained to the specified value. The line direction is based on the RelativeTo property:
  • Attachment0 - The line direction is the primary axis of Attachment0.
  • Attachment1 - The line direction is the primary axis of Attachment1.
  • World - The line direction must be specified.

@roblox/enum/VelocityConstraintMode.Plan.documentation:
The velocity components in the plane are constrained to the specified values. The plane tangents are based on the RelativeTo property:
  • Attachment0 - The plane tangents are the two axes of Attachment0.
  • Attachment1 - The plane tangents are the two axes of Attachment1.
  • World - The two plane tangents must be specified

@roblox/enum/VelocityConstraintMode.Vect.documentation:
The velocity components must be equal to the vector components specified. The coordinate system of the vector is based on the RelativeTo property:
  • Attachment0 - The vector components are in the coordinate system defined by the axes of Attachment0.
  • Attachment1 - The vector components are in the coordinate system defined by the axes of Attachment1.
  • World - The coordinate system is in the world and the vector components must be specified.

@roblox/global/Enum.VelocityConstraintMo.documentation: The velocity constraint mode property controls how the linear velocity of the attachment(s) is constrained.

@roblox/enum/CustomCameraMode.Default.documentation: The default camera mode is classic.

@roblox/enum/CustomCameraMode.Classic.documentation: Camera tracks the player but will not automatically rotate if the player walks left or right.

@roblox/enum/CustomCameraMode.Follow.documentation: Camera tracks the player and automatically rotates if the player walks left or right.

@roblox/global/Enum.VerticalScrollBarPos.documentation: This enum is used for ScrollingFrame.VerticalScrollBarPosition to indicate vertical scroll bar positioning.

@roblox/enum/ElasticBehavior.WhenScrolla.documentation: Scrolling is elastic when there is content to be scrolled to.

@roblox/enum/ElasticBehavior.Always.documentation: Scrolling is always elastic, even when there isn't content available to scroll to.

@roblox/enum/ElasticBehavior.Never.documentation: Scrolling is never elastic and the canvas will never scroll beyond its bounds.

@roblox/global/Enum.ElasticBehavior.documentation: This enum is used by ScrollingFrame.ElasticBehavior to control when elastic scrolling is active on touch‑enabled devices.

@roblox/enum/SurfaceGuiSizingMode.FixedS.documentation: Renders with a fixed size set using SurfaceGui.CanvasSize.

@roblox/enum/SurfaceGuiSizingMode.Pixels.documentation: Renders with a variable size based on SurfaceGui.PixelsPerStud and the SurfaceGui's size in studs.

@roblox/global/Enum.SurfaceGuiSizingMode.documentation: Used by SurfaceGui.SizingMode to control the sizing behavior of a SurfaceGui.

@roblox/enum/ComputerCameraMovementMode..documentation: The default camera movement mode is classic.
Camera tracks the player but will not automatically rotate if the player walks left or right.
Camera tracks the player and automatically rotates if the player walks left or right.
The camera has a fixed Y position, but can be rotated around the player.
The camera toggles between locked and free rotation with the right mouse button.

@roblox/global/Enum.ComputerCameraMoveme.documentation: The camera movement mode currently in-use by the client.

@roblox/enum/GuiState.Idle.documentation: The GUI currently has no state.

@roblox/enum/GuiState.Hover.documentation: The GUI is being hovered over by the user.

@roblox/enum/GuiState.Press.documentation: The GUI is being pressed/held down by the user.

@roblox/enum/GuiState.NonInteractable.documentation: The GUI cannot be interacted with and therefore has no states.

@roblox/enum/SubscriptionPaymentStatus.P.documentation: Payment for the subscription has been received.

@roblox/enum/SubscriptionPaymentStatus.R.documentation: Payment for the subscription has been refunded.

@roblox/enum/JointCreationMode.All.documentation: Joints are created between any kind of surface. Functions identically to Surface.

@roblox/enum/JointCreationMode.Surface.documentation: Joints are created between any kind of surface. Functions identically to All.

@roblox/enum/JointCreationMode.None.documentation: Joints are never created, no matter what.

@roblox/global/Enum.JointCreationMode.documentation: The way joints are created between two surfaces.

@roblox/enum/MessageType.MessageOutput.documentation: The message is from the standard output channel.

@roblox/enum/MessageType.MessageInfo.documentation: The message is from the information channel.

@roblox/enum/MessageType.MessageWarning.documentation: The message is from the warning channel.

@roblox/enum/MessageType.MessageError.documentation: The message is from the error channel.

@roblox/enum/StreamingPauseMode.Disabled.documentation:
Deprecated:
No change to gameplay due to streaming region availability.

@roblox/global/Enum.StreamingPauseMode.documentation: Determines how a client should handle not having enough content streamed in to continue playing properly.

@roblox/enum/AssetTypeVerification.Defau.documentation: Use the default behavior for asset type verification.

@roblox/enum/AssetTypeVerification.Clien.documentation: Only verify asset types on the client. Asset type verification can not be turned off on the client.

@roblox/enum/AssetTypeVerification.Alway.documentation: Always verify the asset types to be loaded and disallow loading models.

@roblox/global/Enum.AssetTypeVerificatio.documentation: Determines the asset type verification mode.

@roblox/enum/AlignType.PrimaryAxisParall.documentation: Aligns the primary axis to be parallel to the axis given by Constraint.Attachment1.

@roblox/enum/AlignType.PrimaryAxisPerpen.documentation: Aligns the primary axis to be perpendicular to the axis given by Constraint.Attachment1.

@roblox/enum/AlignType.PrimaryAxisLookAt.documentation: Aligns the primary axis to look at the point given by Constraint.Attachment1 or the AlignOrientation.LookAtPosition.

@roblox/enum/AlignType.AllAxes.documentation: Aligns all of the axes of Constraint.Attachment0 to the axes given by Constraint.Attachment1 or to the target orientation provided by AlignOrientation.PrimaryAxis and AlignOrientation.SecondaryAxis.

@roblox/global/Enum.AlignType.documentation: An enum that specifies how the constraint will attempt to align the body associated with the constraint.

@roblox/enum/RenderFidelity.Automatic.documentation: Object's level of detail is dynamically controlled by its distance from the camera (see table above).

@roblox/enum/RenderFidelity.Precise.documentation: Object is rendered in the highest fidelity regardless of its distance from the camera.

@roblox/enum/RenderFidelity.Performance.documentation: Push performance as much as possible, trying to maintain quality if possible, and discarding appearance if that's necessary to reach performance. This means that the performance will always be excellent, but mesh visuals may be affected negatively.

@roblox/global/Enum.RenderFidelity.documentation: Determines the level of detail that solid modeled and mesh parts will be shown in.

@roblox/enum/DragDetectorPermissionPolic.documentation: No players can interact with the DragDetector.
All players can interact with the DragDetector.
Invokes the function registered via DragDetector:SetPermissionPolicyFunction(), enabling/disabling the detector based on whether the function returns true or false.

@roblox/global/Enum.DragDetectorPermissi.documentation: Used to control the permission level for which players can interact with a DragDetector.

@roblox/enum/DragDetectorResponseStyle.G.documentation: For an Anchored object both inside the running experience and in Studio edit mode, the position/orientation of the object will be updated to exactly reflect the proposed motion. For an unanchored object, behavior is the same as for an anchored object; however, in a running experience, the object will be anchored at the start of the drag and restored to unanchored upon drag release.

@roblox/enum/DragDetectorResponseStyle.P.documentation: An Anchored object will default to Geometric behavior as it is not affected by forces. An unanchored object will be moved by constraint forces that attempt to bring it to the desired position and/or orientation given by the proposed motion.

@roblox/enum/DragDetectorResponseStyle.C.documentation: The object will not move at all, but DragFrame will still be updated and you can respond to drag manipulation however you'd like.

@roblox/global/Enum.DragDetectorResponse.documentation: Describes how the clicked object will be treated once the desired motion has been calculated.

@roblox/enum/Limb.Head.documentation: If the limb is a part of the Humanoid's Head.

@roblox/enum/Limb.Torso.documentation: If the limb is a part of the Humanoid's Torso. This includes UpperTorso and LowerTorso for R15 rigs.

@roblox/enum/Limb.LeftArm.documentation: If the limb is a part of the Humanoid's Left Arm. This includes UpperLeftArm, LowerLeftArm, and LeftHand for R15 rigs.

@roblox/enum/Limb.RightArm.documentation: If the limb is a part of the Humanoid's Right Arm. This includes UpperRightArm, LowerRightArm and RightHand for R15 rigs.

@roblox/enum/Limb.LeftLeg.documentation: If the limb is a part of the Humanoid's Left Leg. This includes UpperLeftLeg, LowerLeftLeg and LeftFoot for R15 rigs.

@roblox/enum/Limb.RightLeg.documentation: If the limb is a part of the Humanoid's Right Leg. This includes UpperRightLeg, LowerRightLeg, and RightFoot for R15 rigs.

@roblox/enum/Limb.Unknown.documentation: If a part is not a limb (e.g. running the Humanoid:GetLimb() function and passing it an accessory which is a sibling of the Humanoid will return this value).

@roblox/global/Enum.Limb.documentation: Describes which limb a particular Instance belongs to (assuming the Instance is part of a Humanoid).

@roblox/enum/HorizontalAlignment.Center.documentation: Grid is aligned to the center of its parent along the X axis.

@roblox/enum/HorizontalAlignment.Left.documentation: Grid is aligned to the left edge of its parent.

@roblox/enum/HorizontalAlignment.Right.documentation: Grid is aligned to the right edge of its parent.

@roblox/global/Enum.HorizontalAlignment.documentation: Used by UIGridStyleLayout.HorizontalAlignment to align the layout horizontally within its parent.

@roblox/enum/ListenerLocation.Default.documentation: Behavior depends on the value of VoiceChatService.EnableDefaultVoice and VoiceChatService.UseAudioApi. When using the default voice setup with the audio API, this behaves similarly to Camera.

@roblox/enum/ListenerLocation.None.documentation: No AudioListener will be created by default, but they can be created separately by scripts.

@roblox/enum/ListenerLocation.Character.documentation:
All of the following, resulting in the world being heard from the position of your character while matching the orientation of your camera.
  • An Attachment will be created and parented to the PrimaryPart of the local player's Character model.
  • An AudioListener will be created and parented to the Attachment.
  • An AudioDeviceOutput will be created and parented to SoundService.
  • A Wire will be created and parented to the previously-created AudioListener. The wire's SourceInstance will be set to the previously-created AudioListener and its TargetInstance will be set to the previously-created AudioDeviceOutput.
  • The previously-created Attachment will be updated once per frame to face the same direction as Workspace.CurrentCamera.

@roblox/enum/ListenerLocation.Camera.documentation:
All of the following, resulting in the world being heard from the perspective (postition and orientation) of the camera.
  • An AudioListener will be created and parented to Workspace.CurrentCamera.
  • An AudioDeviceOutput will be created and parented to SoundService.
  • A Wire will be created and parented to the previously-created AudioListener. The wire's SourceInstance will be set to the previously-created AudioListener and its TargetInstance will be set to the previously-created AudioDeviceOutput.

@roblox/global/Enum.ListenerLocation.documentation: Enum used with SoundService.DefaultListenerLocation to determine where an AudioListener is placed by default.

@roblox/enum/GroupMembershipStatus.None.documentation: The player chose not to join, cancelled the prompt, or was not eligible to join the group.

@roblox/enum/GroupMembershipStatus.Joine.documentation: The player successfully joined the group during the prompt.

@roblox/enum/GroupMembershipStatus.JoinR.documentation: The player submitted a request to join the group.

@roblox/enum/GroupMembershipStatus.Alrea.documentation: The player was already a member of the group.

@roblox/global/Enum.GroupMembershipStatu.documentation: Defines the possible outcomes of the GroupService:PromptJoinAsync() method.

@roblox/enum/StartCorner.TopLeft.documentation: Grid starts in top left corner.

@roblox/enum/StartCorner.TopRight.documentation: Grid starts in top right corner.

@roblox/enum/StartCorner.BottomLeft.documentation: Grid starts in bottom left corner.

@roblox/enum/StartCorner.BottomRight.documentation: Grid starts in bottom right corner.

@roblox/global/Enum.StartCorner.documentation: Used by UIGridLayout.StartCorner to decide where the first element is placed.

@roblox/enum/CameraMode.Classic.documentation: Third person camera which can be zoomed into first person.

@roblox/global/Enum.CameraMode.documentation: Used to set Player.CameraMode to determine when first person and third person cameras should be used.

@roblox/enum/TableMajorAxis.RowMajor.documentation: The direct siblings are considered rows.

@roblox/enum/TableMajorAxis.ColumnMajor.documentation: The direct siblings are considered columns.

@roblox/global/Enum.TableMajorAxis.documentation: Used by UITableLayout.MajorAxis to decide whether direct siblings are rows or columns.

@roblox/enum/ProductLocationRestriction..documentation: Item is purchasable only in the Marketplace.
Item is purchasable in the Marketplace and experiences owned by the item creator.
(Default) Item is purchasable in the Marketplace and all experiences.

@roblox/enum/StreamingIntegrityMode.Disa.documentation: Simulation of the replication focus is never paused, regardless of the amount of content streamed in on the client.

@roblox/enum/StreamingIntegrityMode.Mini.documentation: All client-side simulation is paused when content is not streamed in up to the minimum radius.

@roblox/enum/StreamingIntegrityMode.Paus.documentation: Simulation of the replication focus is paused when any part of its bounding box is not in a streamed-in area.

@roblox/global/Enum.StreamingIntegrityMo.documentation: Determines how a user's client should handle not having enough content streamed in.

@roblox/enum/DebuggerPauseReason.Unknown.documentation: Pausing for a reason not covered by other values.

@roblox/enum/DebuggerPauseReason.Excepti.documentation: Pausing on error hit in the code.

@roblox/enum/DebuggerPauseReason.SingleS.documentation: Pausing on an internal breakpoint set by debugger command: e.g. step over, step into, step out of.

@roblox/enum/DebuggerPauseReason.Entrypo.documentation: Pausing at the entry on the script.

@roblox/global/Enum.DebuggerPauseReason.documentation: Reason that the DataModel was paused.

@roblox/enum/AnimationPriority.Idle.documentation: (6) - Recommended priority for character idle animations.

@roblox/enum/AnimationPriority.Movement.documentation: (5) - Recommended priority for walk, run, swim, climb, and other locomotion animations.

@roblox/enum/AnimationPriority.Action.documentation: (4) - Recommended priority for character actions that must override idle and locomotion animations.

@roblox/enum/AnimationPriority.Action4.documentation: (1) - Action4 is the highest priority available, overriding all other priority values.

@roblox/enum/AnimationPriority.Core.documentation: (7) - Lowest priority, intended for use by Roblox default animations and catalog animation bundles.

@roblox/global/Enum.AnimationPriority.documentation: The AnimationPriority Enum determines how concurrently-playing AnimationTracks contribute to the final animation.

@roblox/enum/R15CollisionType.OuterBox.documentation: Dynamically sized collision boxes based on mesh sizes.

@roblox/enum/R15CollisionType.InnerBox.documentation: Fixed size collision boxes, similar to the classic avatar collision.

@roblox/global/Enum.R15CollisionType.documentation: Collision behavior type for a R15 character.

@roblox/enum/QualityLevel.Automatic.documentation: The quality level of graphics is determined automatically depending on the client's setting for either game performance or graphic quality.

@roblox/enum/QualityLevel.Level01.documentation: Graphic quality level 1 - the lowest quality level.

@roblox/enum/QualityLevel.Level21.documentation: Graphic quality level 21, the highest quality level.

@roblox/global/Enum.QualityLevel.documentation: Controls the rendering quality of the game.

@roblox/enum/DebuggerEndReason.ServerShu.documentation: Server terminated the connection because it shut down.

@roblox/enum/DebuggerEndReason.ServerPro.documentation: Server has wrong version of protocol.

@roblox/enum/DebuggerEndReason.Configura.documentation: Got a failure response when trying to configure the server.

@roblox/enum/DebuggerEndReason.RpcError.documentation: An error occurred in the RPC layer.

@roblox/global/Enum.DebuggerEndReason.documentation: Reason for the end of the debugger session.

@roblox/enum/ThreadPoolConfig.Auto.documentation: Let task scheduler make a decision internally.

@roblox/enum/ThreadPoolConfig.Threads1.documentation: Utilize 1 worker thread, ignore the physical CPU core count.

@roblox/enum/ThreadPoolConfig.Threads2.documentation: Utilize 2 worker threads, ignore the physical CPU core count.

@roblox/enum/ThreadPoolConfig.Threads3.documentation: Utilize 3 worker threads, ignore the physical CPU core count.

@roblox/enum/ThreadPoolConfig.Threads4.documentation: Utilize 4 worker threads, ignore the physical CPU core count.

@roblox/enum/ThreadPoolConfig.Threads8.documentation: Utilize 8 worker threads, ignore the physical CPU core count.

@roblox/enum/ThreadPoolConfig.Threads16.documentation: Utilize 16 worker threads, ignore the physical CPU core count.

@roblox/enum/ThreadPoolConfig.PerCore1.documentation: Utilize 1 worker thread per available physical CPU core.

@roblox/enum/ThreadPoolConfig.PerCore2.documentation: Utilize 2 worker threads per available physical CPU core.

@roblox/enum/ThreadPoolConfig.PerCore3.documentation: Utilize 3 worker threads per available physical CPU core.

@roblox/enum/ThreadPoolConfig.PerCore4.documentation: Utilize 4 worker threads per available physical CPU core.

@roblox/global/Enum.ThreadPoolConfig.documentation: Thread pooling scheme for the task scheduler.

@roblox/global/Enum.ContextActionPriorit.documentation: Describes the priority of a context action.

@roblox/enum/VolumetricAudio.Disabled.documentation: Volumetric audio is disabled; sound emanates from a single point.

@roblox/enum/VolumetricAudio.Enabled.documentation: Volumetric audio is enabled; sound emanates from the object's volume.

@roblox/global/Enum.VolumetricAudio.documentation: Controls how the engine renders volumetric audio effects.

@roblox/enum/HumanoidCollisionType.Outer.documentation: Dynamically sized collision boxes based on mesh sizes.

@roblox/enum/HumanoidCollisionType.Inner.documentation: Fixed size collision boxes, similar to the classic avatar collision.

@roblox/enum/TextureQueryType.NonHumanoi.documentation: Texture memory for objects other than Humanoid.
Unreferenced texture memory for objects other than Humanoid.

@roblox/global/Enum.TextureQueryType.documentation: Used to get memory information about textures.

@roblox/enum/LoadCharacterLayeredClothin.documentation: The behavior of the default setting is not constant. It can mean Disabled or Enabled depending on what the global back-end flag settings are currently.
This means layered clothing will not be equipped on characters in the experience.
This means layered clothing will be equipped on characters in the experience (Although MeshPartHeadsAndAccessories also need to be enabled for the experience).

@roblox/global/Enum.LoadCharacterLayered.documentation: Indicates whether characters spawning into an experience will have layered clothing accessories equipped on them.

@roblox/enum/ZIndexBehavior.Global.documentation: The ZIndex property overrides the default value computed from the depth in the hierarchy.

@roblox/enum/ZIndexBehavior.Sibling.documentation: The ZIndex property controls the order in which the GuiObject renders relative to its siblings.

@roblox/global/Enum.ZIndexBehavior.documentation: Used by LayerCollector.ZIndexBehavior to control how the GuiObject.ZIndex property behaves for descendants.

@roblox/enum/ActuatorType.None.documentation: The motor and servo components are both disabled.

@roblox/enum/ActuatorType.Motor.documentation: The motor component is enabled. Motor properties are active and the actuator will apply continuous force.

@roblox/enum/ActuatorType.Servo.documentation: The servo component is enabled. Servo properties are active and the actuator will apply force to approach the servo's target.

@roblox/global/Enum.ActuatorType.documentation: The active physics component of the constraint.

@roblox/enum/UIFlexMode.None.documentation: The parent GuiObject is unaffected and neither shrinks nor grows.

@roblox/enum/UIFlexMode.Grow.documentation: Sets an effective 1:0 grow‑shrink ratio on the parent GuiObject. Objects set to Grow never shrink below their basis size, so overflow may occur if the container becomes smaller than the flex line's combined basis size.

@roblox/enum/UIFlexMode.Shrink.documentation: Sets an effective 0:1 grow‑shrink ratio on the parent GuiObject. Objects set to Shrink never grow above their basis size, so underflow may occur if the container becomes larger than the flex line's combined basis size.

@roblox/enum/UIFlexMode.Fill.documentation: Sets an effective 1:1 grow‑shrink ratio on the parent GuiObject. This setting ensures the flex line always fills the container, even if the container size changes.

@roblox/enum/UIFlexMode.Custom.documentation: Enables the GrowRatio and ShrinkRatio properties for the UIFlexItem, allowing for relative growth or shrinking of the parent GuiObject in a ratio compared to other flex objects also under control of a UIFlexItem.

@roblox/global/Enum.UIFlexMode.documentation: Used with UIFlexItem.FlexMode to define how the parent GuiObject grows or shrinks.

@roblox/global/Enum.AudioWindowSize.documentation: For audio effects that use some internal buffering, determines the window-size used.

@roblox/enum/LuauTypeCheckMode.Default.documentation: Uses the engine-default type checking mode.

@roblox/enum/LuauTypeCheckMode.Nonstrict.documentation: Scripts are type-checked in nonstrict mode.

@roblox/enum/LuauTypeCheckMode.Strict.documentation: Scripts are type-checked in strict mode.

@roblox/global/Enum.LuauTypeCheckMode.documentation: The Luau type checking mode for scripts in the experience.

@roblox/enum/DevTouchCameraMovementMode..documentation: The camera will move based on the player's settings.
Camera tracks the player but will not automatically rotate if the player walks left or right.
Camera tracks the player and automatically rotates if the player walks left or right.
The camera has a fixed Y position, but can be rotated around the player.

@roblox/global/Enum.DevTouchCameraMoveme.documentation: Overwrites the camera mode if the player is on a touch device.

@roblox/enum/WrapLayerDebugMode.None.documentation: This debug rendering mode does nothing. This is the default value.

@roblox/enum/WrapLayerDebugMode.BoundCag.documentation: This debug mode visualizes corresponding cage mesh vertices bound to an underlying WrapTarget. In order to find corresponding vertices between different cages, the Wrap Deformer algorithm uses UV matching. As long as your WrapLayer cage mesh share the same UV layout as WrapTarget, its vertices will be marked as "bound".

@roblox/enum/WrapLayerDebugMode.LayerCag.documentation: This debug mode shows the resulting layer mesh as a whole. The deformer will use vertex locations from the previous layer for all unbound vertices.

@roblox/enum/WrapLayerDebugMode.BoundCag.documentation: The same as BoundCage but also visualizes how bound vertices were moved. You can use this mode to identify where they belong on a previous layer and where they are located on the current layer.

@roblox/enum/WrapLayerDebugMode.Referenc.documentation: This debug mode shows the original inner cage mesh as it was created.

@roblox/enum/WrapLayerDebugMode.Rbf.documentation: This debug mode visualizes the internal RBF solver state. You can estimate the wrap deformer's expected behavior by looking at this state. All renderable mesh vertices move from a "big sphere" to a "small sphere" along a corresponding line connecting two spheres.

@roblox/enum/WrapLayerDebugMode.OuterCag.documentation: This debug mode shows the original outer cage mesh as it was created.

@roblox/global/Enum.WrapLayerDebugMode.documentation: The Studio-only property for quickly visualizing and debugging meshes with inner cage and outer cages.

@roblox/global/Enum.WaterForce.documentation: The WaterForce Enum is used to work with Terrain water cells.

@roblox/enum/BorderMode.Outline.documentation: As GuiObject.BorderSizePixel increases, the border grows outward. The dimensions of the GuiObject's contents do not change.

@roblox/enum/BorderMode.Middle.documentation: As GuiObject.BorderSizePixel increases, the border grows evenly inward and outward. The dimensions of the GuiObject's contents are reduced at a 1:1 ratio.

@roblox/enum/BorderMode.Inset.documentation: As GuiObject.BorderSizePixel increases, the border grows evenly inward only. The dimensions of the GuiObject's contents are reduced at a 1:2 ratio.

@roblox/global/Enum.BorderMode.documentation: Used by GuiObject.BorderMode to determine where borders are placed.

@roblox/enum/ParticleFlipbookLayout.None.documentation: Disable flipbook features and use the texture as a single static texture over the particle's lifetime.

@roblox/enum/ParticleFlipbookLayout.Cust.documentation: A custom grid size defined by FlipbookSizeX and FlipbookSizeY.

@roblox/global/Enum.ParticleFlipbookLayo.documentation: Determines the layout of the flipbook texture.

@roblox/enum/DevTouchMovementMode.UserCh.documentation: Allows players to choose their desired control scheme from the in-experience menu. This is the default movement mode.

@roblox/enum/DevTouchMovementMode.ClickT.documentation: The player's character will attempt to move to a location in the world when the player taps a location.

@roblox/enum/DevTouchMovementMode.Script.documentation: The player's character will not respond to default controls; any character movement must be defined in custom scripts.

@roblox/enum/DevTouchMovementMode.Dynami.documentation: The player's character is controlled with a virtual thumbstick that appears when they touch the lower portion of the screen. Jumping is controlled with a separate button.

@roblox/global/Enum.DevTouchMovementMode.documentation: Overrides the movement mode of players who are playing on touch-enabled devices.

@roblox/global/Enum.DominantAxis.documentation: Used by UIAspectRatioConstraint.DominantAxis for resizing the object to maintain the aspect ratio.

@roblox/enum/CompletionItemTag.Deprecate.documentation: Indicates that the completion is deprecated, applying a penalty towards its score and crossing it out in the completion list.

@roblox/enum/CompletionItemTag.Incorrect.documentation: Indicates that the completion is a member and being accessed with the wrong index type (e.g. using : to access a property), hiding it from the completion list.

@roblox/enum/CompletionItemTag.PluginPer.documentation: Indicates that the completion requires Plugin security level to access, hiding it if the client lacks this level.

@roblox/enum/CompletionItemTag.CommandLi.documentation: Indicates that the completion requires Command line security level to access, hiding it if the client lacks this level.

@roblox/enum/CompletionItemTag.RobloxPer.documentation: Indicates that the completion requires core script security level to access, hiding it if the client lacks this level.

@roblox/enum/CompletionItemTag.AddParens.documentation: Instructs the editor to add parentheses before the cursor after inserting the given completion, if accepted.

@roblox/enum/CompletionItemTag.PutCursor.documentation: Instructs the editor to add parentheses before the cursor and move the cursor into the parentheses after inserting the given completion, if accepted.

@roblox/enum/CompletionItemTag.TypeCorre.documentation: Indicates that the completion is type correct in the current context, granting a bonus to its score.

@roblox/enum/CompletionItemTag.ClientSer.documentation: Indicates that the completion is being accessed from the wrong side of the client/server boundary (e.g. Players.LocalPlayer in a server script), hiding it from the completion list.

@roblox/global/Enum.CompletionItemTag.documentation: Determines the tags for completion items in ScriptEditorService:RegisterAutocompleteCallback().

@roblox/enum/AudioApiRollout.Disabled.documentation: Voice chat will use an internal voice chat implementation that is automatic and hidden.

@roblox/enum/AudioApiRollout.Automatic.documentation: Currently means the same thing as Disabled, but will be updated to mean Enabled in the future.

@roblox/enum/AudioApiRollout.Enabled.documentation: Voice chat can be customized or controlled via AudioDeviceInputs.

@roblox/global/Enum.AudioApiRollout.documentation: Used to determine whether voice chat is represented and controlled by AudioDeviceInput objects.

@roblox/enum/VerticalAlignment.Center.documentation: Grid is aligned to the center of its parent along the Y axis.

@roblox/enum/VerticalAlignment.Top.documentation: Grid is aligned to the top edge of its parent.

@roblox/enum/VerticalAlignment.Bottom.documentation: Grid is aligned to the bottom edge of its parent.

@roblox/global/Enum.VerticalAlignment.documentation: Used by UIGridStyleLayout.VerticalAlignment to align the layout vertically within its parent.

@roblox/enum/TextureMode.Stretch.documentation: For a Trail, the texture will stretch out based on the lifetime of the trail, and shrink inwards if the trail's attachments stop moving. For a Beam, the texture will repeat TextureLength times across the beam's overall length. See here for details.

@roblox/enum/TextureMode.Wrap.documentation: For a Trail, the texture will be tiled as the length of the trail changes, but the textures will remain stationary relative to their attachments. For a Beam, the texture repetitions will equal the beam's overall length (in studs) divided by its TextureLength. See here for details.

@roblox/enum/TextureMode.Static.documentation: For a Trail, the texture will be rolled out as the attachments move, and they will remain in place until their lifetime is met. This setting is ideal for trail textures that should appear "stamped" where rendered, such as paw prints or tire tracks. This value is not supported for Beam and therefore behaves identically to Wrap.

@roblox/global/Enum.TextureMode.documentation: Describes how the texture of a Trail or Beam behaves.

@roblox/global/Enum.GearType.documentation: Deprecated: This enum is deprecated because it's used by deprecated properties. Don't use it.

@roblox/enum/ScaleType.Stretch.documentation: The image is stretched to fit within the element.

@roblox/enum/ScaleType.Slice.documentation: 9-Slice scaling: slice the image into 9 regions and apply different scaling rules to each region. The slice boundaries are determined by ImageLabel.SliceCenter or ImageButton.SliceCenter. See UI 9-Slice Design for more information. .

@roblox/enum/ScaleType.Tile.documentation: The image is tiled to fit within the element. For example, if the element is twice the X dimension of the image, the image will appear twice (2 tiles).

@roblox/enum/ScaleType.Fit.documentation: The image is scaled fit within the element X or Y dimension (whichever fits first).

@roblox/enum/ScaleType.Crop.documentation: The image is cropped to fit within the element.

@roblox/global/Enum.ScaleType.documentation: Determines how an image (of a ImageLabel or ImageButton) is scaled.

@roblox/global/Enum.WaterDirection.documentation: This Enum was once used to set the direction of Terrain water.

@roblox/enum/ShowAdResult.ShowCompleted.documentation: The ad was successfully shown to completion.

@roblox/enum/ShowAdResult.AdNotReady.documentation: You are trying to show a full-screen ad before the ad has fully loaded. You might have failed to properly fetch the ad, or the ad might have expired.

@roblox/enum/ShowAdResult.AdAlreadyShowi.documentation: You are trying to show a full-screen ad while another full-screen ad is already playing.

@roblox/enum/ShowAdResult.InternalError.documentation: An unspecified internal error occurred. Try showing the ad again.

@roblox/enum/ShowAdResult.ShowInterrupte.documentation: The ad view of the user has been interrupted. The user might have closed the ad view or left the experience, and should not receive a reward.

@roblox/enum/CloseReason.Unknown.documentation: The server shut down for an unknown reason.

@roblox/enum/CloseReason.RobloxMaintenan.documentation: The server shut down for maintenance.

@roblox/enum/CloseReason.DeveloperShutdo.documentation: The experience developer has shut down the server, or functions bound by BindToClose() have been called inside Studio.

@roblox/enum/CloseReason.DeveloperUpdate.documentation: The experience developer has migrated the server to a new place version.

The mouse icon is forced to always remain hidden/invisible.

@roblox/global/Enum.MarketplaceProductTy.documentation: Indicates if an avatar item is an asset or bundle. Used with MarketplaceService and similar services.

@roblox/enum/LeftRight.Left.documentation: The object is on the left side of its parent (X axis).

@roblox/enum/LeftRight.Center.documentation: The object is centered on the center of its parent (X axis), expanding equally to the left and right of the parent's center.

@roblox/enum/LeftRight.Right.documentation: The object is on the right side of its parent (X axis).

@roblox/global/Enum.LeftRight.documentation: The LeftRight Enum is used to set where the object is on the side of its parent.

@roblox/enum/HumanoidDisplayDistanceType.documentation: A player selecting Viewer on their Humanoid will see the Name and healthbar of other players if those other players are within the distance settings set in the Humanoid selecting Viewer (this can be thought of as the lowest priority, and will not be taken into account if other players are selecting 'Subject' or 'None').

A player selecting Subject on their Humanoid will allow other players to see their Name and healthbar if those other players are within the distance settings set in the Humanoid selecting Subject (this can be thought of as the second highest priority).
A player selecting None on their Humanoid will not have their Name and healthbar displayed to other players under any circumstance (this can be thought of as the highest priority).

@roblox/global/Enum.HumanoidDisplayDista.documentation: HumanoidDisplayDistanceType determines how Humanoid.HealthDisplayDistance, and Humanoid.NameDisplayDistance are used in determining whether a players's name and health are visible to other players.

@roblox/global/Enum.PositionAlignmentMod.documentation: The PositionAlignmentMode Enum is used to select the number of Attachments used in an alignment.

@roblox/enum/PartType.Cylinder.documentation: A cylinder shape oriented along the X axis.

@roblox/enum/PartType.Wedge.documentation: A wedge shape with a slope on one side.

@roblox/enum/PartType.CornerWedge.documentation: A wedge shape with slopes on two sides.

@roblox/enum/AnalyticsProgressionStatus..documentation: Default status. Used for an undefined status.

@roblox/global/Enum.AnalyticsProgression.documentation: This enum is used as an argument in AnalyticsService:FirePlayerProgressionEvent() to describe the status of progression.

@roblox/enum/SizeConstraint.RelativeXY.documentation: The scale of X and Y are independent.

@roblox/enum/SizeConstraint.RelativeXX.documentation: The scale of X is shared with Y.

@roblox/enum/SizeConstraint.RelativeYY.documentation: The scale of Y is shared with X.

@roblox/global/Enum.SizeConstraint.documentation: Used to constrain the scale of a GUI object.

@roblox/enum/FormFactor.Symmetric.documentation: Increases by a rate of 1 along all axes.

@roblox/enum/FormFactor.Brick.documentation: Increases by a rate of 1 along the x- and z- axes, 1.2 along the y-axis.

@roblox/enum/FormFactor.Plate.documentation: Increases by a rate of 1 along the x- and z- axes, 0.4 along the y-axis.

@roblox/enum/FormFactor.Custom.documentation: Increases by a rate as low as .001 along all axes.

@roblox/enum/AlphaMode.Overlay.documentation: Overlays the ColorMap on top of the underlying part color based on the map's alpha channel.

@roblox/enum/AlphaMode.Transparency.documentation: Uses the ColorMap alpha channel to control the transparency of the surface.

@roblox/enum/AlphaMode.TintMask.documentation: Uses the ColorMap alpha channel to control the amount of SurfaceAppearance.Color tinting.

@roblox/enum/AlphaMode.Opaque.documentation: Ignores the ColorMap alpha channel and assumes an opacity value of 1 everywhere.

@roblox/global/Enum.AlphaMode.documentation: Used by SurfaceAppearance.AlphaMode to determine how the alpha channel of the SurfaceAppearance.ColorMap of a SurfaceAppearance is used.

@roblox/enum/ScrollBarInset.None.documentation: The canvas will never be inset for the respective scroll bar.

@roblox/enum/ScrollBarInset.ScrollBar.documentation: The canvas will only be inset if the respective scroll bar is showing.

@roblox/enum/ScrollBarInset.Always.documentation: The canvas will always be inset for the respective scroll bar, regardless of whether that scroll bar is showing.

@roblox/global/Enum.ScrollBarInset.documentation: This enum is used with ScrollingFrame.HorizontalScrollBarInset and ScrollingFrame.VerticalScrollBarInset to indicate whether the canvas should be inset by ScrollBarThickness for the respective scroll bar.

@roblox/enum/AudioSimulationFidelity.Non.documentation: No acoustic simulation occurs; only direction and distance are taken into account.

@roblox/enum/AudioSimulationFidelity.Aut.documentation: The audio engine simulates transmission, diffraction, and reflections at a level of detail suitable to most devices.

@roblox/global/Enum.AudioSimulationFidel.documentation: Enum which determines how detailed audio simulation should be for AudioEmitters and AudioListeners.

@roblox/enum/RaycastFilterType.Exclude.documentation: Every BasePart in the raycast operation will be considered except those that are descendants of objects in the filter list.

@roblox/enum/RaycastFilterType.Include.documentation: Only BaseParts which are descendants of objects in the filter list will be considered in the raycast operation.

@roblox/global/Enum.RaycastFilterType.documentation: Used in a RaycastParams object to determine how its FilterDescendantsInstances list will be used.

@roblox/enum/PoseEasingStyle.Linear.documentation: Poses interpolate linearly between key frames.

@roblox/enum/PoseEasingStyle.Constant.documentation: Poses do not interpolate but snap to the key frame indicated by the PoseEasingDirection.

@roblox/enum/PoseEasingStyle.Elastic.documentation: Pose interpolation will overshoot like it is elastic.

@roblox/enum/PoseEasingStyle.Cubic.documentation: Deprecated - Use PoseEasingStyle.CubicV2. Pose interpolation is a cubic curve between keyframes based on the PoseEasingDirection.

@roblox/enum/PoseEasingStyle.Bounce.documentation: Pose interpolation produces a bounce like effect between key frames.

@roblox/enum/PoseEasingStyle.CubicV2.documentation: Pose interpolation is a cubic curve between keyframes based on PoseEasingDirection.

@roblox/enum/ImageCombineType.BlendSourc.documentation: Blends pixels from the source with pixels from the destination using source over alpha blending.

@roblox/enum/ImageCombineType.Overwrite.documentation: Overwrites all pixels in the destination image with pixels from the source image.

@roblox/enum/ImageCombineType.Add.documentation: Adds pixels from the source and pixels from the destination together.

@roblox/enum/ImageCombineType.Multiply.documentation: Multiplies pixels from the source and pixels from the destination together. RGBA values are multiplied as values between 0 and 1. Values lower than 1 have a darkening effect on the image.

@roblox/enum/ImageCombineType.AlphaBlend.documentation: Blends pixels from the source with pixels from the destination based on the alpha of the source pixels. Unlike BlendSourceOver, the destination color in AlphaBlend affects the resulting color of the image, regardless of the destination color's alpha.

@roblox/global/Enum.ImageCombineType.documentation: Enum for determining how two images are combined together.

@roblox/enum/MarketplaceBulkPurchaseProm.documentation: User confirmed the purchase and the transaction has been processed.
User confirmed the purchase, but the transaction cannot be sent to the backend for processing.

@roblox/global/Enum.MarketplaceBulkPurch.documentation: The status of the BulkPurchasePrompt after player interaction.

@roblox/enum/UIDragDetectorBoundingBehav.documentation: Mimics EntireObject behavior for a UI object that's entirely contained by the BoundingUI, or else HitPoint for a UI object that's partially outside the BoundingUI.
Bounds the entire dragged UI object within the BoundingUI.
Bounds the dragged UI only by the exact hit/grab point and its respective position after translation/rotation.

@roblox/global/Enum.UIDragDetectorBoundi.documentation: Used with UIDragDetector to determine bounding behavior of the dragged UI object when UIDragDetector.BoundingUI is set.

@roblox/enum/RecommendationItemContentTy.documentation: The item is static, such as an image.
The item is dynamic; for example, it is a video.
The item is interactive, such as a 3D model or a mini-game.

@roblox/enum/MeshPartHeadsAndAccessories.documentation: The default option to control the Workspace.MeshPartHeadsAndAccessories feature. This currently has the same meaning as "Enabled".

@roblox/enum/ScreenOrientation.Landscape.documentation: A preference where the game is displayed landscape (horizontally) with the bottom of the device on the left side of the screen.
A preference where the game is displayed landscape (horizontally) with the bottom of the device on the right side of the screen.

A preference where the game is displayed landscape (horizontally) with the bottom of the device on the left of right side of the screen depending on the device's orientation (the sensor determines which side allows for the game to be displayed right-side-up).

@roblox/enum/ScreenOrientation.Portrait.documentation: A preference where the game is displayed portrait (vertically) with the bottom of the device on the bottom of the screen.

@roblox/enum/ScreenOrientation.Sensor.documentation: A preference where the game is displayed depending on the best match to the device's current orientation - either landscape (left/right) or portrait.

@roblox/global/Enum.ScreenOrientation.documentation: The preference of in-game screen orientation on hand-held devices.

@roblox/enum/AdornCullingMode.Automatic.documentation: Automatically culls adornment based on distance.

@roblox/enum/AdornCullingMode.Never.documentation: Never culls adornment. Adornment is always visible.

@roblox/enum/Style.BridgeStyleSupports.documentation: Truss beams contain bridge style supports.

@roblox/enum/Style.NoSupports.documentation: Truss beams do not contain supports.

@roblox/global/Enum.Style.documentation: The Style Enum is used to set what style of supports the TrussPart has.

@roblox/enum/HashAlgorithm.Blake2b.documentation: Used to compute a 256-bit (32-byte) hash digest using the BLAKE2b algorithm.

@roblox/enum/HashAlgorithm.Blake3.documentation: Used to compute a 256-bit (32-byte) hash digest using the BLAKE3 algorithm.

@roblox/enum/HashAlgorithm.Md5.documentation: Used to compute a 128-bit (16-byte) hash digest using the MD5 algorithm.

@roblox/enum/HashAlgorithm.Sha1.documentation: Used to compute a 160-bit (20-byte) hash digest using the SHA-1 algorithm.

@roblox/enum/HashAlgorithm.Sha256.documentation: Used to compute a 256-bit (32-byte) hash digest using the SHA256 algorithm.

@roblox/global/Enum.HashAlgorithm.documentation: A Cryptographic hash function to use in EncodingService methods.

@roblox/enum/EnviromentalPhysicsThrottle.documentation: Automatically adjusts throttle level based on performance.
No throttling; every physics step runs.
Maximum throttling; physics is effectively frozen.
Runs 1 out of every 2 steps (50% reduction). If Workspace.PhysicsSteppingMethod is set to Adaptive, skipping is based on groups of 4 steps instead of individual steps.
Runs 1 out of every 4 steps (75% reduction). If Workspace.PhysicsSteppingMethod is set to Adaptive, skipping is based on groups of 4 steps instead of individual steps.
Runs 1 out of every 8 steps (87.5% reduction). If Workspace.PhysicsSteppingMethod is set to Adaptive, skipping is based on groups of 4 steps instead of individual steps.
Runs 1 out of every 16 steps (93.75% reduction). If Workspace.PhysicsSteppingMethod is set to Adaptive, skipping is based on groups of 4 steps instead of individual steps.

@roblox/global/Enum.EnviromentalPhysicsT.documentation: Used to control the throttle rate of Roblox's physics engine.

@roblox/enum/PredictionStatus.None.documentation: The instance will not be resimulated; classic simulation rules apply instead.

@roblox/global/Enum.PredictionStatus.documentation: Enum used with RunService:GetPredictionStatus() to check the status of a specific instance.

@roblox/enum/DataStoreRequestType.GetAsy.documentation: Refers to GetAsync() and the read of UpdateAsync().

@roblox/enum/DataStoreRequestType.SetInc.documentation: Refers to SetAsync(), IncrementAsync(), RemoveAsync(), and the write of UpdateAsync() when it returns a non-nil value.
Refers to SetAsync() IncrementAsync(), RemoveAsync(), and the write of UpdateAsync() while using an OrderedDataStore.

@roblox/enum/DataStoreRequestType.Standa.documentation: Refers to GetAsync(), GetVersionAsync(), GetVersionAtTimeAsync(), and the read of UpdateAsync() for DataStore.
Refers to SetAsync(), IncrementAsync(), and the write of UpdateAsync() for DataStore.

@roblox/enum/DataStoreRequestType.Ordere.documentation: Refers to GetAsync() and the read of UpdateAsync() for OrderedDataStore.
Refers to SetAsync(), IncrementAsync(), and the write of UpdateAsync() for OrderedDataStore.
Refers to GetSortedAsync() for OrderedDataStore. GetRequestBudgetForRequestType()with this enum will return0`.

@roblox/global/Enum.DataStoreRequestType.documentation: Indicates the type of data store request being made.

@roblox/enum/DebuggerStatus.Timeout.documentation: Timed out while waiting for response.

@roblox/enum/DebuggerStatus.ConnectionLo.documentation: Connection to the debugger was lost.

@roblox/enum/DebuggerStatus.InvalidState.documentation: The request was not appropriate for the current debugger state.

@roblox/enum/DebuggerStatus.InvalidArgum.documentation: One of the request arguments was invalid.

@roblox/enum/DebuggerStatus.ConnectionCl.documentation: Connection closed while waiting for response.

@roblox/enum/HighlightDepthMode.AlwaysOn.documentation: Allows the Highlight to display regardless if there are objects between the camera and the highlighted object. This means the viewer is always able to see the highlight regardless of what is between the highlighted object and the camera.

@roblox/enum/HighlightDepthMode.Occluded.documentation: Hides the Highlight if there are objects between the camera and the highlighted object. This means the viewer is only able to see the object if there are no obstructing objects between the highlighted object and the camera's view.

@roblox/global/Enum.HighlightDepthMode.documentation: Controls how the Highlight effect displays with respect to other objects in the world.

@roblox/enum/AnalyticsLogLevel.Trace.documentation: Trace is the noisiest level, rarely (if ever) enabled for a production app.

@roblox/enum/AnalyticsLogLevel.Error.documentation: When functionality is unavailable or expectations broken.

@roblox/enum/AnalyticsLogLevel.Fatal.documentation: The most critical level, Fatal events demand immediate attention.

@roblox/enum/Technology.Legacy.documentation: Deprecated: This option is deprecated and cannot be selected in Studio.

@roblox/enum/Technology.Voxel.documentation: Uses a 4×4×4 voxel map for light and shadow calculation.

@roblox/enum/Technology.Compatibility.documentation: Simulates the removed legacy technology and is now deprecated. To achieve a similar look, use Voxel Lighting and add a ColorGradingEffect post‑processing effect set to the Retro preset.

@roblox/enum/Technology.ShadowMap.documentation: Features shadow mapping that produces more realistic and crisp shadows from sunlight or directional light sources.

@roblox/enum/Technology.Future.documentation: Features the most advanced technology for high-fidelity lighting and shadows.

@roblox/enum/Technology.Unified.documentation: Deprecated: This option is deprecated and cannot be selected in Studio.

@roblox/global/Enum.Technology.documentation: Enum used by Lighting.Technology to represent the different lighting systems available for rendering the 3D world.

@roblox/enum/RejectCharacterDeletions.De.documentation: Uses the engine-default behavior (currently equivalent to Enabled).

@roblox/enum/RejectCharacterDeletions.Di.documentation: The server does not reject character deletion requests from clients.

@roblox/enum/RejectCharacterDeletions.En.documentation: The server rejects client attempts to delete player characters.

@roblox/global/Enum.RejectCharacterDelet.documentation: Controls whether the server rejects client attempts to delete player characters.

@roblox/enum/RibbonTool.MaterialPicker.documentation: Deprecated in favor of Material Manager. Don't use.

@roblox/enum/AdShape.HorizontalRectangle.documentation: The ad has an aspect ratio of 16:9 and a minimum size of 8 by 4.5 studs.

@roblox/global/Enum.AdShape.documentation: Describes the form factor of an ad in an AdGui. There is currently only one available size.

@roblox/enum/VibrationMotor.LeftHand.documentation: Left hand motor for VR devices.

@roblox/enum/VibrationMotor.RightHand.documentation: Right hand motor for VR devices.

@roblox/global/Enum.VibrationMotor.documentation: Describes various types of haptic motor sizes and locations.

Deprecated:
Only gear genres matching the allowed genres specified in a place's configuration settings.

@roblox/global/Enum.GearGenreSetting.documentation: Deprecated: This enum is deprecated as it is used by deprecated properties that are no longer functional. It should not be used.

@roblox/enum/ActuatorRelativeTo.Attachme.documentation: The constraint is expressed relative to Attachment0.
The constraint is expressed relative to Attachment1.

@roblox/enum/ActuatorRelativeTo.World.documentation: The constraint is expressed relative to the game world.

@roblox/global/Enum.ActuatorRelativeTo.documentation: The CFrame value in which the body mover constraint is expressed.

@roblox/global/Enum.FilterResult.documentation: Used to determine the result of a text filter request.

@roblox/enum/RenderPriority.Last.documentation: This should run as last, after Character.

@roblox/global/Enum.RenderPriority.documentation: A list of standard reserved values in BindToRenderStep.

@roblox/enum/UserCFrame.Head.documentation: The CFrame of the user's head.

@roblox/enum/UserCFrame.LeftHand.documentation: The CFrame of the user's left hand.

@roblox/enum/UserCFrame.RightHand.documentation: The CFrame of the user's right hand.

@roblox/global/Enum.UserCFrame.documentation: Determines what body part is being tracked by a VR device, and what its CFrame actually is.

@roblox/global/Enum.ConnectionState.documentation: Used to determine the connection state of the client to the game server.

@roblox/enum/UIFlexAlignment.None.documentation: No flex behavior; siblings maintain their defined width or height.

@roblox/enum/UIFlexAlignment.Fill.documentation: Siblings resize to fill the entire parent container, overriding their defined width or height.

@roblox/enum/UIFlexAlignment.SpaceAround.documentation: Siblings maintain their defined width or height. Equal spacing is added on both sides of each sibling.

@roblox/enum/UIFlexAlignment.SpaceBetwee.documentation: Siblings maintain their defined width or height. Equal spacing is added between siblings, but no additional space is added around siblings.

@roblox/enum/UIFlexAlignment.SpaceEvenly.documentation: Siblings maintain their defined width or height. Equal spacing is added both between and around siblings.

@roblox/global/Enum.UIFlexAlignment.documentation: In a UIListLayout flex layout, specifies how to distribute extra space in the parent container.

@roblox/enum/MembershipType.None.documentation: The player does not have an active paid membership.

@roblox/enum/MembershipType.Premium.documentation: The player has an active Premium membership.

@roblox/global/Enum.MembershipType.documentation: The membership type of a Player.

@roblox/enum/AnimatorRetargetingMode.Def.documentation: Retargeting in default state, opt-in initially but subject to change.

@roblox/enum/Genre.All.documentation: The game's genre is set to All. The game will be listed as all possible genres.

@roblox/enum/Genre.TownAndCity.documentation: The game's genre is set to Town and City.

@roblox/enum/Genre.Fantasy.documentation: The game's genre is set to Fantasy.

@roblox/enum/Genre.SciFi.documentation: The game's genre is set to SciFi (Science Fiction).

@roblox/enum/Genre.Ninja.documentation: The game's genre is set to Ninja.

@roblox/enum/Genre.Scary.documentation: The game's genre is set to Scary.

@roblox/enum/Genre.Pirate.documentation: The game's genre is set to Pirate.

@roblox/enum/Genre.Adventure.documentation: The game's genre is set to Adventure.

@roblox/enum/Genre.Sports.documentation: The game's genre is set to Sports.

@roblox/enum/Genre.Funny.documentation: The game's genre is set to Funny.

@roblox/enum/Genre.WildWest.documentation: The game's genre is set to Wild West.

@roblox/enum/Genre.War.documentation: The game's genre is set to War.

@roblox/enum/Genre.SkatePark.documentation: The game's genre is set to Skate Park.

@roblox/enum/Genre.Tutorial.documentation: The game's genre is set to Tutorial.

@roblox/global/Enum.Genre.documentation:
Deprecated:
Used to represent the type of game.

@roblox/enum/ImageAlphaType.Default.documentation: The default behavior in which neither color nor alpha values are locked.

@roblox/enum/ImageAlphaType.LockCanvasAl.documentation: The alpha values of the image will not be modified.

@roblox/enum/ImageAlphaType.LockCanvasCo.documentation: The color values of the image will not be modified.

@roblox/global/Enum.ImageAlphaType.documentation: Enum for determining if the alpha or color is locked while combining two images.

@roblox/enum/PoseEasingDirection.In.documentation: The EasingStyle curve is reversed, with the easing becoming linear as it approaches the next keyframe.

@roblox/enum/PoseEasingDirection.Out.documentation: EasingStyle curves are applied in the forward direction, from the current keyframe to the next.

@roblox/enum/PoseEasingDirection.InOut.documentation: Two easing curves are applied back-to-back with the linear ends of the curves meeting in the middle.

@roblox/global/Enum.PoseEasingDirection.documentation: Used exclusively by Pose.EasingDirection to specify direction of the EasingStyle curve.

@roblox/enum/AvatarPromptResult.Permissi.documentation: Denied permission to take the prompted action.

@roblox/enum/AvatarPromptResult.Failed.documentation: Failure while trying to take the prompted action.

@roblox/global/Enum.AvatarPromptResult.documentation: The result of prompt operations of AvatarEditorService.

@roblox/enum/TeleportState.RequestedFrom.documentation: The server has requested that the client teleport.

@roblox/enum/TeleportState.Started.documentation: The client has started attempting to teleport.

@roblox/enum/TeleportState.WaitingForSer.documentation: The client is waiting for the server to respond to the teleport request.

@roblox/enum/TeleportState.InProgress.documentation: The teleport is currently in progress. The player usually disconnects and teleports to the destination after this.

@roblox/global/Enum.TeleportState.documentation: Determines the current teleportation state of a player.

@roblox/global/Enum.RigType.documentation: The type of rig being imported with the 3D Importer.

@roblox/enum/IKControlConstraintSupport..documentation: The default option for IKControls. The default is currently set to Enabled.
Disables support for constraints for IKControls. When disabled, IKControls still work, but ignore physics constraints.

@roblox/global/Enum.IKControlConstraintS.documentation: Values for Workspace.IKControlConstraintSupport. Sets the support for constraints for IKControls in your experience.

@roblox/global/Enum.HttpContentType.documentation: Specifies the value of the HTTP Content-Type header which describes the HTTP request data type.

@roblox/enum/AssetFetchStatus.Failure.documentation: The asset failed to load successfully. Subsequent attempts are likely to fail; there may be something wrong with the Content string.

@roblox/enum/AssetFetchStatus.None.documentation: The engine has no information about this asset. The engine never tried to load it.

@roblox/enum/AssetFetchStatus.Loading.documentation: The engine is in the middle of trying to load this asset.

@roblox/enum/AssetFetchStatus.TimedOut.documentation: The engine tried to load this asset but timed out. Future attempts to load may succeed.

@roblox/enum/BreakpointRemoveReason.Requ.documentation: Breakpoint removal was requested by user or a command.

@roblox/enum/BreakpointRemoveReason.Scri.documentation: Script that contained the breakpoint has changed.
Script that contained the breakpoint was removed.

@roblox/global/Enum.BreakpointRemoveReas.documentation: Reason that a breakpoint was removed.

@roblox/global/Enum.ListDisplayMode.documentation: Used to set the scrolling mode of the Advanced Objects tab.

@roblox/enum/FrameStyle.Custom.documentation: Uses the frame's GuiObject.BackgroundColor3, GuiObject.BorderColor3, and GuiObject.BackgroundTransparency properties to determine the frame's appearance. It has no padding; elements with the position UDim2.new(0, 0, 0, 0) will appear at the frame's top-left corner.

@roblox/enum/FrameStyle.ChatBlue.documentation: Causes the frame to appear similar to a Dialog with its Tone property set to DialogTone.Neutral. Like ChatGreen and ChatRed, this has a padding of fifteen pixels on all sides.

@roblox/enum/FrameStyle.RobloxSquare.documentation: Causes the frame to appear as a translucent dark gray rectangle with a padding of five pixels on all sides.

@roblox/enum/FrameStyle.RobloxRound.documentation: Causes the frame to appear as a translucent dark gray rectangle with rounded edges. Like RobloxSquare, this has a padding of five pixels on all sides.

@roblox/enum/FrameStyle.ChatGreen.documentation: Causes the frame to appear similar to a Dialog with its Tone property set to DialogTone.Friendly. Like ChatBlue and ChatRed, this has a padding of fifteen pixels on all sides.

@roblox/enum/FrameStyle.ChatRed.documentation: Causes the frame to appear similar to a Dialog with its Tone property set to DialogTone.Enemy. Like ChatBlue and ChatGreen, this has a padding of fifteen pixels on all sides.

@roblox/enum/FrameStyle.DropShadow.documentation: Causes the frame to appear as a translucent gray rectangle with blurred sides. The blur is more apparent on the bottom edge. It has a padding of eight pixels on all sides.

@roblox/global/Enum.FrameStyle.documentation: Used to set the style of a Frame.

@roblox/enum/UIDragDetectorDragRelativit.documentation: Designates the input and return values as the absolute target position/rotation in the space defined by DragSpace.
Designates the input and return values as the change from the current position/rotation in the space defined by DragSpace.

@roblox/global/Enum.UIDragDetectorDragRe.documentation: Used with DragDetector to set the paradigm which defines the relativity of inputs/outputs from a custom drag function.

@roblox/enum/AvatarUnificationMode.Defau.documentation: Uses the engine-default avatar unification state.

@roblox/global/Enum.AvatarUnificationMod.documentation: Controls whether the R6 to R15 adapter is active, allowing R15 avatars to join R6 experiences.

@roblox/enum/ControlMode.Classic.documentation: Allows the camera to be moved by clicking and dragging with the right mouse button.

@roblox/enum/ControlMode.MouseLockSwitch.documentation: Similar to classic, but allows the player to toggle mouse locking, causing the camera to rotate as the player moves the mouse (without holding down a button).

@roblox/global/Enum.ControlMode.documentation: The ControlMode Enum sets how the player is controlled.

@roblox/enum/TextXAlignment.Left.documentation: Alignment starts at the left side of the GUI object.

@roblox/enum/TextXAlignment.Right.documentation: Alignment starts at the right side of the GUI object.

@roblox/enum/TextXAlignment.Center.documentation: Aligned starts at the center of the GUI object and spreads equally left and right.

@roblox/enum/DevComputerMovementMode.Use.documentation: Allows players to choose their desired control scheme from the in-experience menu. This is the default movement mode.

@roblox/enum/DevComputerMovementMode.Key.documentation: The player's character will be controlled using the keyboard and mouse.

@roblox/enum/DevComputerMovementMode.Cli.documentation: Players can only move through the experience by clicking a target location. The player's character will automatically jump when reaching a surmountable obstacle/gap while moving to the click destination.

@roblox/enum/DevComputerMovementMode.Scr.documentation: Disables all default controls and allows you to script your own control scheme.

@roblox/global/Enum.DevComputerMovementM.documentation: Sets the movement mode of players who are playing on computers.

@roblox/enum/SortOrder.Name.documentation: Elements are ordered by their Instance.Name in alphanumeric order.

@roblox/enum/SortOrder.Custom.documentation:
Deprecated:
Elements are ordered by the function passed to UIGridStyleLayout:SetCustomSortFunction().

@roblox/enum/SortOrder.LayoutOrder.documentation: Elements are ordered by GuiObject.LayoutOrder in ascending order; for example 0 will be placed before 1.

@roblox/global/Enum.SortOrder.documentation: Used by UIGridStyleLayout.SortOrder to order the elements in the layout.

@roblox/enum/TextTruncate.AtEnd.documentation: Text is truncated at the end of the text; extra graphemes that cannot fit into the space are replaced with .... Word boundaries are respected if possible. For example, if the control is between -> and <- like so: ->Long text is truncated at the en<-d of the last complete word The text will be: Long text is truncated at the...

@roblox/enum/TextTruncate.SplitWord.documentation: If the end of the line occurs in the middle of a word, the text is truncated inside of that word. Extra graphemes that cannot fit into the space are replaced with .... For example, if the control is between -> and <- like so: ->Long text is truncated at the en<-d of the last complete word The text will be: Long text is truncated at the en...

@roblox/global/Enum.TextTruncate.documentation: Controls the truncation of text when using the TextTruncate property.

@roblox/enum/DisplaySize.Small.documentation: Viewport is categorized as small. Applies to most tablet/mobile/handheld devices.

@roblox/enum/DisplaySize.Medium.documentation: Viewport is categorized as medium. Applies to most laptops and monitors.

@roblox/enum/DisplaySize.Large.documentation: Viewport is categorized as large. Applies to most TVs or larger.

@roblox/global/Enum.DisplaySize.documentation: This enum is used with GuiService.ViewportDisplaySize to indicate the internally-categorized rendering size of the viewport.

@roblox/enum/CameraType.Attach.documentation: Camera moves with the subject at a fixed offset and will rotate as the subject rotates.

@roblox/enum/CameraType.Watch.documentation: Camera is stationary but will rotate to keep the subject in the center of the screen.

@roblox/enum/CameraType.Track.documentation: Camera moves with the subject but does not rotate automatically.

@roblox/enum/CameraType.Follow.documentation: Camera moves with the subject and rotates to keep the subject in the center.

@roblox/enum/CameraType.Custom.documentation: Default mode used by Roblox core scripts.

@roblox/enum/CameraType.Scriptable.documentation: No default behavior. Used when developers need to script custom behavior.

@roblox/enum/CameraType.Orbital.documentation: The camera has a fixed Y position, but can be rotated around the player.

@roblox/global/Enum.CameraType.documentation: Describes the camera behavior mode if using the default PlayerScripts.

@roblox/global/Enum.OrientationAlignment.documentation: The OrientationAlignmentMode Enum is used to select the number of Attachments used in an alignment.

@roblox/enum/AudioSubType.Music.documentation: Represents an asset which contains music.

@roblox/enum/AudioSubType.SoundEffect.documentation: Represents an asset which is a sound effect.

@roblox/global/Enum.AudioSubType.documentation: The categorization of an audio asset.

@roblox/enum/MarketplaceItemPurchaseStat.documentation: Unable to purchase item due to Roblox system error.
Unable to purchase item because user already owns the item. Users can only own one copy of non-limited item.
Unable to purchase item because of insufficient Robux.
User has reached the max quantity allowed per user set by the creator for limited items.
The user has exceeded our purchase request limit.
This item is restricted to a group of users and the purchaser is not in this group.
The provided price does not match the item price. Most likely the price changed since displayed to the user.
The purchaser is the same user as the seller, for a resale purchase.
The user does not have sufficient premium membership to purchase this item.
The item is not allowed to be sold in the place.

@roblox/global/Enum.MarketplaceItemPurch.documentation: The status of the item purchase through MarketplaceService.

@roblox/enum/WeldConstraintPreserve.All.documentation: All WeldConstraints will be returned in the recommended table.

@roblox/enum/WeldConstraintPreserve.None.documentation: WeldConstraints will be ignored and not returned in the recommended table.

@roblox/enum/WeldConstraintPreserve.Touc.documentation: Only WeldConstraints that connect touching parts in the performed operation will be returned in the recommended table.

@roblox/enum/StudioStyleGuideColor.MainB.documentation: The primary background color used by the toolbar and windows.

@roblox/enum/StudioStyleGuideColor.Title.documentation: The color of windows' title bars.

@roblox/enum/StudioStyleGuideColor.Dropd.documentation: The color of dropdown menus, like those found in the Properties window.

@roblox/enum/StudioStyleGuideColor.Toolt.documentation: The background color of tooltips, like those seen when hovering over buttons on the toolbar or properties in the Properties window.

@roblox/enum/StudioStyleGuideColor.Scrol.documentation: The color of scrollbar handles, like those seen in the Explorer window.
The background color of scrollbars, like those seen in the Explorer window.

@roblox/enum/StudioStyleGuideColor.TabBa.documentation: The background color of the tab bar, like the one where the script editor is opened.

@roblox/enum/StudioStyleGuideColor.Tab.documentation: The color of tabs on the tab bar, like the ones opened when the script editor is opened.

@roblox/enum/StudioStyleGuideColor.Ribbo.documentation: The color of a tab on the toolbar menu.
The background color of the toolbar.

@roblox/enum/StudioStyleGuideColor.Butto.documentation: The background color of clickable buttons.

@roblox/enum/StudioStyleGuideColor.MainB.documentation: The background color of clickable buttons that are the primary action.

@roblox/enum/StudioStyleGuideColor.Ribbo.documentation: The background color of buttons on the toolbar.

@roblox/enum/StudioStyleGuideColor.ViewP.documentation: The background color of the game viewport.

@roblox/enum/StudioStyleGuideColor.Input.documentation: The background color of input fields, like those found in the Explorer window.

@roblox/enum/StudioStyleGuideColor.GameS.documentation: The color of items within tables in the settings window.
The color of tooltips in the settings window.

@roblox/enum/StudioStyleGuideColor.Emula.documentation: The color of the bar shown when the mobile emulator is active.
The color of the device and physical size dropdowns in the emulator bar.

@roblox/enum/StudioStyleGuideColor.Color.documentation: The background color of the color picker.

@roblox/enum/StudioStyleGuideColor.Borde.documentation: The color of borders, like those found in the Properties window.

@roblox/enum/StudioStyleGuideColor.Shado.documentation: The color of shadows rendered under floating items like dropdowns.

@roblox/enum/StudioStyleGuideColor.Statu.documentation: The color of the status bar shown at the bottom of Studio, if it is visible.

@roblox/enum/StepFrequency.Hz60.documentation: The bound function is called at 60 Hz.

@roblox/enum/StepFrequency.Hz30.documentation: The bound function is called at 30 Hz.

@roblox/enum/StepFrequency.Hz15.documentation: The bound function is called at 15 Hz.

@roblox/enum/StepFrequency.Hz10.documentation: The bound function is called at 10 Hz.

@roblox/enum/StepFrequency.Hz5.documentation: The bound function is called at 5 Hz.

@roblox/enum/StepFrequency.Hz1.documentation: The bound function is called at 1 Hz.

@roblox/global/Enum.StepFrequency.documentation: Enum used with RunService:BindToSimulation() to indicate the frequency at which the bound function is called.

@roblox/enum/AdUnitStatus.Inactive.documentation: The ad unit isn't currently serving an ad and it may be configured incorrectly. An AdGui with this status will display its fallback image.

@roblox/enum/AdUnitStatus.Active.documentation: The ad unit is currently serving an ad. Players will observe sponsored content in an AdGui and an AdPortal will teleport users that walk through.

@roblox/global/Enum.AdUnitStatus.documentation: Exposes the status of an immersive ad.

@roblox/enum/RecommendationImpressionTyp.documentation: A complete view of the item.
The item has failed to render.

@roblox/enum/CollisionFidelity.Default.documentation: Collision model uses a voxel-based convex-hull decomposition that is relatively fast but may not be highly accurate, especially for holes, doorways, and cavities in general.

@roblox/enum/CollisionFidelity.Hull.documentation: Collision model uses the convex hull of the visual mesh.

@roblox/enum/CollisionFidelity.Box.documentation: Collision model uses a bounding box that encompasses the visual mesh.

@roblox/enum/CollisionFidelity.PreciseCo.documentation: Collison model uses a convex-hull decomposition of the visual mesh which is computed by a variation of an algorithm called HACD. This option is the most accurate representation of collision geometry for complex objects with built-in tolerances to reduce the total number of convex-hulls by compromising on accuracy when justified.

@roblox/global/Enum.CollisionFidelity.documentation: Determines behavior of the collision hitbox for MeshPart and PartOperation instances.

@roblox/enum/ReceiptType.RobuxTransferSe.documentation: Used for processing receipts for the user who initiated a Robux transfer. The receipt's PlayerId is the sender's user ID and includes a TransferRequestId field.

@roblox/enum/ReceiptType.RobuxTransferRe.documentation: Used for processing receipts for the user who received Robux via a transfer. The receipt's PlayerId is the receiver's user ID and includes a TransferRequestId field.

@roblox/global/Enum.ReceiptType.documentation: ReceiptType is used to work with server-sided receipt processing.

@roblox/enum/TickCountSampleMethod.Fast.documentation: Compute time using a faster, but less precise method.

@roblox/enum/TickCountSampleMethod.Bench.documentation: Dynamically decide between using ''Fast'' and ''Precise'' depending on performance.

@roblox/enum/TickCountSampleMethod.Preci.documentation: Compute time using a precise method.

@roblox/global/Enum.TickCountSampleMetho.documentation: Controls the precision of a timer.

@roblox/global/Enum.FillDirection.documentation: Used by UIGridStyleLayout.FillDirection to control which direction elements are placed.

@roblox/enum/StreamOutBehavior.LowMemory.documentation: Only stream out when memory is low.

@roblox/enum/StreamOutBehavior.Opportuni.documentation: Stream out content that is significantly outside of the current Workspace.StreamingTargetRadius.

@roblox/global/Enum.StreamOutBehavior.documentation: Determines how content is streamed out from Player clients.

@roblox/enum/CreatorType.User.documentation: The place is owned by a single user.

@roblox/enum/CreatorType.Group.documentation: The place is owned by a group.

@roblox/enum/CreateContentResult.Permiss.documentation: The user does not have the required permissions to perform this operation.

@roblox/enum/CreateContentResult.Storage.documentation: The storage budget limit for DataModel-scoped content was exceeded.

@roblox/enum/ClientAnimatorThrottlingMod.documentation: The default animation throttling mode defined by Roblox.

@roblox/global/Enum.ClientAnimatorThrott.documentation: An Enum describing various animation throttling modes on clients.

@roblox/enum/ResamplerMode.Default.documentation: Bilinear filtering of the four near pixels in the image.

@roblox/enum/ResamplerMode.Pixelated.documentation: Nearest neighbor filtering of the closest pixel in the image.

@roblox/enum/SurfaceConstraint.Hinge.documentation: Makes the side appear with a yellow hinge. Any part connected to this hinge will stick to the side and rotate using physics.

@roblox/enum/SurfaceConstraint.SteppingM.documentation: Functions identically to a motor. It may have functioned differently in the past, but that functionality no longer seems to exist.

@roblox/enum/SurfaceConstraint.Motor.documentation: Acts the same as a Hinge, but has a grey ring around it and automatically rotates any part connected to it.

@roblox/global/Enum.SurfaceConstraint.documentation: This item is deprecated and is replaced by the SurfaceType enum.

@roblox/enum/VoiceChatDistanceAttenuatio.documentation: Represents a distance attenuation curve that follows the inverse-squared law. This is identical to the default distance attenuation of an AudioEmitter instance.

Represents a linear-squared distance attenuation curve with a minimum distance of 7 and a maximum distance of 80. This is identical to the distance attenuation used in the internal-only default voice setup that does not use AudioDeviceInput and AudioEmitter objects.

@roblox/global/Enum.VoiceChatDistanceAtt.documentation: Enum used for preset distance attenuation curve options in the default voice chat setup.

@roblox/enum/DeveloperMemoryTag.Internal.documentation: General data that doesn't have any categorization. This could be due to either internal reasons, or because it simply isn't being tracked categorically.

@roblox/enum/DeveloperMemoryTag.Instance.documentation: All the Instances present in memory.

@roblox/enum/DeveloperMemoryTag.LuaHeap.documentation: All of the data in Luau, including everything happening in core scripts, built-in data types, etc.

@roblox/enum/DeveloperMemoryTag.Script.documentation: All memory being manipulated and referenced by scripts.

@roblox/enum/DeveloperMemoryTag.Graphics.documentation: Rendering solid models (stuff made with Union, Negate, etc.).
Spatial hash lookup tables of the game world that are used for rendering.
Rendering of textures in the game world.
Rendering of texture composition maps that are generated for Humanoids.

@roblox/enum/DeveloperMemoryTag.Animatio.documentation: Playback of Animations on Humanoids and AnimationControllers.

@roblox/enum/DeveloperMemoryTag.Navigati.documentation: Pathfinding for Humanoids via the PathfindingService.

@roblox/global/Enum.PrivilegeType.documentation: Deprecated: This enum should not be used for new work.

@roblox/enum/AntiAliasing.Disabled.documentation: Disables anti-aliasing, resulting in hard edges.

@roblox/enum/AntiAliasing.Enabled.documentation: Enables anti-aliasing, resulting in soft edges.

@roblox/global/Enum.AntiAliasing.documentation: Determines whether anti-aliasing is applied when drawing on the instance.

@roblox/enum/WebStreamClientType.SSE.documentation: Traditional Server-Sent Events (SSE) client. Requires text/event-stream to be returned in the Content-Type header. Messages in the stream will follow the event stream format.

@roblox/enum/WebStreamClientType.RawStre.documentation: General purpose HTTP streaming client. It can connect to any server that provides streaming data transfer (e.g. chunked encoding). It provides no guarantees about the stream format.

@roblox/enum/WebStreamClientType.WebSock.documentation: WebSocket client that provides a bidirectional communication channel over a TCP connection.

@roblox/global/Enum.WebStreamClientType.documentation: Specifies what type of streaming to use when creating a WebStreamClient.

@roblox/enum/HapticEffectType.Custom.documentation: Allows for application of a custom haptic waveform through the HapticEffect:SetWaveformKeys() method.

@roblox/enum/HapticEffectType.UIHover.documentation: Useful for when a player browses over an object (often a UI object) without the intention of triggering its action; it can also alert the player that they have browsed over an interactable object. This effect type is subtle and does not disrupt the gameplay experience.

@roblox/enum/HapticEffectType.UIClick.documentation: Useful for when a player has selected an object (often a UI object) with the intention of triggering its action. This effect type is crisp and it provides immediate feedback without being overwhelming.

@roblox/enum/HapticEffectType.UINotifica.documentation: Useful for when there is an inbound message that should draw the player's attention away from their current gameplay and prompt them that the notification requires immediate attention or action.

@roblox/enum/HapticEffectType.GameplayEx.documentation: Useful to signify a large-scale physics event that triggers impact across a large portion of a given scene.
