This effect is high intensity in order to represent the magnitude of the impact and it lingers for a longer period of time than GameplayCollision.

@roblox/enum/HapticEffectType.GameplayCo.documentation: This effect is a large immediate rumble that dies down quickly, useful to signify a clear and purposeful impact between objects.

@roblox/global/Enum.UiMessageType.documentation: Controls the UI message under the GuiService.

@roblox/enum/PlaybackState.Begin.documentation: The tween has been created, but has yet to be played. After exiting this state, the tween never enters it again.

@roblox/enum/PlaybackState.Delayed.documentation: The tween is waiting for the duration specified in its TweenInfo.DelayTime. After the delay elapses, the tween plays.

@roblox/enum/PlaybackState.Playing.documentation: The tween is currently in progress.

@roblox/enum/PlaybackState.Paused.documentation: The tween is paused in the middle of playing.

@roblox/enum/PlaybackState.Cancelled.documentation: The tween was cancelled before completion.

@roblox/global/Enum.PlaybackState.documentation: Describes the current state of a Tween in its Tween.PlaybackState property.

@roblox/enum/SaveFilter.SaveAll.documentation: Saves all data, including both world and game-related information.

@roblox/global/Enum.SaveFilter.documentation:
Deprecated: This deprecated enum is used by DataModel.SavePlace which has also been deprecated. Neither should be used in new work.
Used by DataModel.SavePlace to determine the type of save operation This enum determines which aspects of the current place are saved, based on the following options.

@roblox/enum/ChatPrivacyMode.AllUsers.documentation: A player can chat with all users in a game.

@roblox/enum/ChatPrivacyMode.NoOne.documentation: A player cannot chat with any other users in a game.

@roblox/enum/ChatPrivacyMode.Friends.documentation: A player can only chat with users in a game that are on their friends list.

@roblox/enum/LightingStyle.Realistic.documentation: The most advanced and realistic lighting and shadows Roblox can deliver.

@roblox/enum/LightingStyle.Soft.documentation: A flat, retro-Roblox look with softer lights and shadows.

@roblox/global/Enum.LightingStyle.documentation: Enum used by Lighting.LightingStyle to indicate the artistic intent behind lighting in the experience.

@roblox/enum/SelfViewPosition.LastPositi.documentation: The position of the self view when it was last closed.

@roblox/enum/SelfViewPosition.TopLeft.documentation: Top-left corner of the screen, with slight padding from the top and left edges.

@roblox/enum/SelfViewPosition.TopRight.documentation: Top-right corner of the screen, with slight padding from the top and right edges.

@roblox/enum/SelfViewPosition.BottomLeft.documentation: Bottom-left corner of the screen, with slight padding from the bottom and left edges.

@roblox/enum/SelfViewPosition.BottomRigh.documentation: Bottom-right corner of the screen, with slight padding from the bottom and right edges.

@roblox/global/Enum.SelfViewPosition.documentation: Defines the screen location of the current player's self view.

@roblox/enum/PathfindingUseImprovedSearc.documentation: Uses the legacy pathfinding search algorithm.
Uses the improved pathfinding search algorithm.

@roblox/global/Enum.PathfindingUseImprov.documentation: Controls whether PathfindingService uses an improved search algorithm.

@roblox/enum/AudioFilterType.Peak.documentation: Filter that boosts or reduces sound near a specified Frequency.

@roblox/enum/AudioFilterType.LowShelf.documentation: Filter that boosts or reduces sound below a specified Frequency.

@roblox/enum/AudioFilterType.HighShelf.documentation: Filter that boosts or reduces sound above a specified Frequency.

@roblox/enum/AudioFilterType.Lowpass12dB.documentation: Filter that cuts sound above a specified Frequency, at a slope of -12dB/octave.

@roblox/enum/AudioFilterType.Lowpass24dB.documentation: Filter that cuts sound above a specified Frequency, at a slope of -24dB/octave.

@roblox/enum/AudioFilterType.Lowpass48dB.documentation: Filter that cuts sound above a specified Frequency, at a slope of -48dB/octave.

@roblox/enum/AudioFilterType.Highpass12d.documentation: Filter that cuts sound below a specified Frequency, at a slope of -12dB/octave.

@roblox/enum/AudioFilterType.Highpass24d.documentation: Filter that cuts sound below a specified Frequency, at a slope of -24dB/octave.

@roblox/enum/AudioFilterType.Highpass48d.documentation: Filter that cuts sound below a specified Frequency, at a slope of -48dB/octave.

@roblox/enum/AudioFilterType.Bandpass.documentation: Filter that only allows sound near a specified Frequency to be heard.

@roblox/enum/AudioFilterType.Notch.documentation: Filter that cuts sound near a specified Frequency.

@roblox/enum/AudioFilterType.Lowpass6dB.documentation: Filter that cuts sound above a specified Frequency, at a slope of -6dB/octave.

@roblox/enum/RunContext.Legacy.documentation: Runs in legacy script containers dependent on the type of script uses such as LocalScript or Script.

@roblox/enum/RunContext.Plugin.documentation: Runs as a descendant of Plugin instances.

@roblox/enum/InstanceFileSyncStatus.NotS.documentation: The Instance is not being synced or errored.

@roblox/enum/InstanceFileSyncStatus.Erro.documentation: The Instance is a sync root that has errored and stopped syncing.

@roblox/enum/InstanceFileSyncStatus.Sync.documentation: The Instance is being synced as the root of a sync tree.
The Instance is being synced because it is a descendant of a sync root.

@roblox/enum/InstanceFileSyncStatus.Ance.documentation: The Instance is not currently being synced because the root of its sync tree is Errored.

@roblox/global/Enum.InstanceFileSyncStat.documentation: Describes the file sync status of an Instance.

@roblox/enum/PathStatus.ClosestNoPath.documentation:
Deprecated:
Path doesn't exist, returns path to closest point.

@roblox/enum/PathStatus.ClosestOutOfRang.documentation:
Deprecated:
Goal is out of MaxDistance range, returns path to closest point you can reach within MaxDistance.

@roblox/enum/PathStatus.FailStartNotEmpt.documentation:
Deprecated:
Failed to compute path; the starting point is not empty.

@roblox/enum/PathStatus.FailFinishNotEmp.documentation:
Deprecated:
Failed to compute path; the finish point is not empty.

@roblox/global/Enum.PathStatus.documentation: The success of a Path generated by PathfindingService.

@roblox/enum/EasingStyle.Sine.documentation: Speed is determined by a sine wave for a gentle easing motion.

@roblox/enum/EasingStyle.Back.documentation: Slightly overshoots the target, then backs into place.

@roblox/enum/EasingStyle.Quad.documentation: Similar to Sine but with a slightly sharper curve based on quadratic interpolation.

@roblox/enum/EasingStyle.Quart.documentation: Similar to Cubic but with an even sharper curve based on quartic interpolation.

@roblox/enum/EasingStyle.Quint.documentation: Similar to Quart but with an even sharper curve based on quintic interpolation.

@roblox/enum/EasingStyle.Bounce.documentation: Bounces backwards multiple times after reaching the target, before eventually settling.

@roblox/enum/EasingStyle.Elastic.documentation: Moves as if attached to a rubber band, overshooting the target several times.

@roblox/enum/EasingStyle.Exponential.documentation: The sharpest curve based on exponential interpolation.

@roblox/enum/EasingStyle.Circular.documentation: Follows a circular arc, such that acceleration is more sudden and deceleration more gradual versus Quint or Exponential.

@roblox/enum/EasingStyle.Cubic.documentation: Similar to Quad but with a slightly sharper curve based on cubic interpolation.

@roblox/global/Enum.EasingStyle.documentation: Enum used with TweenInfo.new to control the motion of a Tween.

@roblox/enum/PathWaypointAction.Walk.documentation: Walk action needed to reach the next waypoint.

@roblox/enum/PathWaypointAction.Jump.documentation: Jump action needed to reach the next waypoint.

@roblox/global/Enum.PathWaypointAction.documentation: Describes the action to take when a PathWaypoint is reached.

@roblox/enum/CameraPanMode.Classic.documentation: Enables swipe and pan on mobile devices, and disables edge bump camera controls. Default.

@roblox/enum/CameraPanMode.EdgeBump.documentation: Disables swipe to pan on mobile devices, and enables edge bump camera controls. It does not affect Windows or Mac users.

@roblox/global/Enum.CameraPanMode.documentation: The CameraPanMode Enum represents the available pan modes for Camera:SetCameraPanMode().

@roblox/enum/AspectType.FitWithinMaxSize.documentation: The object will be the maximum size possible within its own AbsoluteSize.

@roblox/enum/AspectType.ScaleWithParentS.documentation: The object's maximum size will be the size of the parent while still maintaining the aspect ratio.

@roblox/global/Enum.AspectType.documentation: Used by UIAspectRatioConstraint.AspectType to control sizing behavior.

@roblox/enum/GameAvatarType.PlayerChoice.documentation: The rig (either R6 or R15) determined by a player's character settings set on the website in the 'Edit Avatar' page.

@roblox/global/Enum.GameAvatarType.documentation: Value indicating which type of avatar an experience uses.

@roblox/enum/ProductPurchaseChannel.InEx.documentation: The purchase was made inside of an experience.

@roblox/enum/ProductPurchaseChannel.Expe.documentation: The purchase was made outside of an experience, on the Store tab of the experience details page.

@roblox/enum/ProductPurchaseChannel.AdRe.documentation: The product was rewarded to the user when they watched a video ad to completion.

@roblox/enum/ProductPurchaseChannel.Comm.documentation: The user acquired the product as a benefit of purchasing commerce merchandise from the developer of the experience.

@roblox/global/Enum.ProductPurchaseChann.documentation:
Enum which works with MarketplaceService to represent how the
user acquired the developer product.

@roblox/enum/BreakReason.Other.documentation: Pausing for a reason not covered by other values, for example if the user hit "Pause" button.

@roblox/enum/BreakReason.Error.documentation: Pausing on error hit in the code.

@roblox/enum/BreakReason.SpecialBreakpoi.documentation: Pausing on an internal breakpoint set by debugger command: e.g. step over, step into, step out of.

@roblox/enum/PermissionLevelShown.Game.documentation: Member must have no security permissions in order to be shown.

@roblox/enum/PermissionLevelShown.Roblox.documentation: Member must have security permissions less than or equal to RobloxPlaceSecurity to be shown.
Member must have security permissions less than or equal to RobloxScriptSecurity to be shown.

@roblox/enum/PermissionLevelShown.Studio.documentation: Member must have security permissions less than or equal to LocalUserSecurity to be shown.

@roblox/enum/PermissionLevelShown.Roblox.documentation: Member is shown no matter what security it has.

@roblox/global/Enum.PermissionLevelShown.documentation: Used to set the highest permission level that APIs have to have in order to be shown in the Object Browser.

@roblox/enum/SubscriptionState.NeverSubs.documentation: User has never subscribed to the product.

@roblox/enum/SubscriptionState.Subscribe.documentation: Subscription is active and will renew.
Subscription is active and will not renew.
Subscription is active and renewal payment is pending.

@roblox/enum/AuthorityMode.Server.documentation: Server authority with client side prediction and rollback enabled.

@roblox/enum/AuthorityMode.Automatic.documentation: Traditional distributed authority model where, for each instance, the engine decides whether the server or a client should be the authority; BasePart:SetNetworkOwner() can be used to influence the decision.

@roblox/enum/ChatStyle.Classic.documentation: Displays chats in the chat user interface at the top-left corner of the screen.

@roblox/enum/ChatStyle.Bubble.documentation: Displays chats in a bubble above the sender's head.

@roblox/enum/ChatStyle.ClassicAndBubble.documentation: Has the effects of Classic and Bubble combined.

@roblox/global/Enum.ChatStyle.documentation: The ChatStyle Enum is used to set the style of Chat used in a game via the Players:SetChatStyle() method.

@roblox/enum/PackagePermission.None.documentation: Permission data is not available for the current user or group roleset.

@roblox/enum/PackagePermission.NoAccess.documentation: The current user or group roleset doesn't have access.

@roblox/enum/PackagePermission.Revoked.documentation: The current user's or group roleset's permission is revoked.

@roblox/enum/PackagePermission.UseView.documentation: The current user or group roleset can download a copy of the package from Roblox.

@roblox/enum/PackagePermission.Edit.documentation: The current user or group roleset can download a copy of the package from Roblox and publish package changes to Roblox.

@roblox/enum/PackagePermission.Own.documentation: The current user or group roleset can download a copy of the page from Roblox, publish package changes to Roblox, and manage who has access to the package.

@roblox/global/Enum.PackagePermission.documentation: Indicates the current user's or group roleset's permission to the package.

@roblox/enum/ThumbnailSize.Size48x48.documentation: Thumbnail resolution is 48 pixels x 48 pixels.

@roblox/enum/ThumbnailSize.Size180x180.documentation: Thumbnail resolution is 180 pixels x 180 pixels.

@roblox/enum/ThumbnailSize.Size420x420.documentation: Thumbnail resolution is 420 pixels x 420 pixels.

@roblox/enum/ThumbnailSize.Size60x60.documentation: Thumbnail resolution is 60 pixels x 60 pixels.

@roblox/enum/ThumbnailSize.Size100x100.documentation: Thumbnail resolution is 100 pixels x 100 pixels.

@roblox/enum/ThumbnailSize.Size150x150.documentation: Thumbnail resolution is 150 pixels x 150 pixels.

@roblox/enum/ThumbnailSize.Size352x352.documentation: Thumbnail resolution is 352 pixels x 352 pixels.

@roblox/enum/PhysicsSteppingMethod.Fixed.documentation: All simulated assemblies inside the workspace will advance forward at 240 Hz. This option is best for optimal stability and simulation accuracy.

@roblox/enum/PhysicsSteppingMethod.Adapt.documentation: The engine attempts to assign optimal simulation rates for individual assemblies of either 240 Hz, 120 Hz, or 60 Hz. This setting is optimized for performance.

@roblox/enum/BorderStrokePosition.Outer.documentation: The stroke renders on the outer border of the parent UI element.

@roblox/enum/BorderStrokePosition.Center.documentation: The stroke renders on the center border of the parent UI element.

@roblox/enum/BorderStrokePosition.Inner.documentation: The stroke renders on the inner border of the parent UI element.

@roblox/global/Enum.BorderStrokePosition.documentation: Used by UIStroke.BorderStrokePosition to determine the stroke's position on its parent's border.

@roblox/global/Enum.UICaptureMode.documentation: Used to determine what UI elements should be captured with CaptureService.

@roblox/enum/IKControlType.Transform.documentation: It is a full 6-DoF constraint. Aligns the EndEffector CFrame to that of the Target. It is the default value.

@roblox/enum/IKControlType.Position.documentation: Aligns the EndEffector position to that of the Target .

@roblox/enum/IKControlType.Rotation.documentation: Aligns the EndEffector rotation to that of the Target.

@roblox/enum/IKControlType.LookAt.documentation: Moves and orients the whole chain to make the forward axis on the EndEffector point at a position in the world specified by Target.

@roblox/global/Enum.IKControlType.documentation: Used on IKControl to specify their Type, to change their behavior.

@roblox/enum/ReverbType.NoReverb.documentation: No sound reverb. Audio is not changed from default.

@roblox/enum/ReverbType.GenericReverb.documentation: Sound reverb is changed to a generic reverb effect.

@roblox/enum/ReverbType.PaddedCell.documentation: Sound reverb is changed to sound like the player is in a padded cell.

@roblox/enum/ReverbType.Room.documentation: Sound reverb is changed to sound like the player is in a room.

@roblox/enum/ReverbType.Bathroom.documentation: Sound reverb is changed to sound like the player is in a bathroom.

@roblox/enum/ReverbType.LivingRoom.documentation: Sound reverb is changed to sound like the player is in a living room.

@roblox/enum/ReverbType.StoneRoom.documentation: Sound reverb is changed to sound like the player is in a stone room.

@roblox/enum/ReverbType.Auditorium.documentation: Sound reverb is changed to sound like the player is in an auditorium.

@roblox/enum/ReverbType.ConcertHall.documentation: Sound reverb is changed to sound like the player is in a concert hall.

@roblox/enum/ReverbType.Cave.documentation: Sound reverb is changed to sound like the player is in a cave.

@roblox/enum/ReverbType.Arena.documentation: Sound reverb is changed to sound like the player is in an arena.

@roblox/enum/ReverbType.Hangar.documentation: Sound reverb is changed to sound like the player is in a hangar.

@roblox/enum/ReverbType.CarpettedHallway.documentation: Sound reverb is changed to sound like the player is in a carpeted hallway.

@roblox/enum/ReverbType.Hallway.documentation: Sound reverb is changed to sound like the player is in a hallway.

@roblox/enum/ReverbType.StoneCorridor.documentation: Sound reverb is changed to sound like the player is in a stone corridor.

@roblox/enum/ReverbType.Alley.documentation: Sound reverb is changed to sound like the player is in an alley.

@roblox/enum/ReverbType.Forest.documentation: Sound reverb is changed to sound like the player is in a forest.

@roblox/enum/ReverbType.City.documentation: Sound reverb is changed to sound like the player is in a city.

@roblox/enum/ReverbType.Mountains.documentation: Sound reverb is changed to sound like the player is in the mountains.

@roblox/enum/ReverbType.Quarry.documentation: Sound reverb is changed to sound like the player is in a quarry.

@roblox/enum/ReverbType.Plain.documentation: Sound reverb is changed to sound like the player is an open plain.

@roblox/enum/ReverbType.ParkingLot.documentation: Sound reverb is changed to sound like the player is in a parking lot.

@roblox/enum/ReverbType.SewerPipe.documentation: Sound reverb is changed to sound like the player is in a sewer pipe.

@roblox/enum/ReverbType.UnderWater.documentation: Sound reverb is changed to sound like the player is underwater.

@roblox/global/Enum.ReverbType.documentation: The ReverbType Enum allows you to make audio in your game sound different, depending on what "area" the sounds are in.

@roblox/enum/TextYAlignment.Top.documentation: Alignment starts at the top of the GUI object.

@roblox/enum/TextYAlignment.Center.documentation: Aligned starts at the center of the GUI object and spreads equally toward the top and bottom.

@roblox/enum/TextYAlignment.Bottom.documentation: Alignment starts at the bottom of the GUI object.

@roblox/enum/UserInputState.Begin.documentation: Occurs when an InputObject starts to interact with the experience. For example, a mouse button down, a key down, or when the player begins touching the screen.

@roblox/enum/UserInputState.Change.documentation: Occurs each frame an InputObject has already begun interacting with the experience and part of its state is changing. For example, movement of the mouse position, a gamepad thumbstick movement, an analog gamepad trigger button change, or screen touch point change.

@roblox/enum/UserInputState.End.documentation: Occurs when an InputObject finishes interacting with the experience. For example, a mouse button up, a key up, or when the player stops touching the screen.

@roblox/enum/UserInputState.Cancel.documentation: A special circumstance state that indicates this input is no longer relevant, particularly with ContextActionService. For example, binding two action-handling functions will cause the first to Cancel if an input was already in-progress when the second was bound.

@roblox/enum/UserInputState.None.documentation: A state that should never be seen in an experience; essentially just marks the end of the enum.

@roblox/global/Enum.UserInputState.documentation: This enum describes the state of an input that is currently or was recently performed.

@roblox/enum/KeyCode.Unknown.documentation: Blank value that represents no key being pressed.

@roblox/enum/KeyCode.KeypadZero.documentation: The 0 key on the keypad cluster.

@roblox/enum/KeyCode.KeypadOne.documentation: The 1 key on the keypad cluster.

@roblox/enum/KeyCode.KeypadTwo.documentation: The 2 key on the keypad cluster.

@roblox/enum/KeyCode.KeypadThree.documentation: The 3 key on the keypad cluster.

@roblox/enum/KeyCode.KeypadFour.documentation: The 4 key on the keypad cluster.

@roblox/enum/KeyCode.KeypadFive.documentation: The 5 key on the keypad cluster.

@roblox/enum/KeyCode.KeypadSix.documentation: The 6 key on the keypad cluster.

@roblox/enum/KeyCode.KeypadSeven.documentation: The 7 key on the keypad cluster.

@roblox/enum/KeyCode.KeypadEight.documentation: The 8 key on the keypad cluster.

@roblox/enum/KeyCode.KeypadNine.documentation: The 9 key on the keypad cluster.

@roblox/enum/KeyCode.KeypadPeriod.documentation: The . key on the keypad cluster.

@roblox/enum/KeyCode.KeypadDivide.documentation: The / key on the keypad cluster.

@roblox/enum/KeyCode.KeypadMultiply.documentation: The * key on the keypad cluster.

@roblox/enum/KeyCode.KeypadMinus.documentation: The - key on the keypad cluster.

@roblox/enum/KeyCode.KeypadPlus.documentation: The + key on the keypad cluster.

@roblox/enum/KeyCode.KeypadEnter.documentation: The Enter key on the keypad cluster.

@roblox/enum/KeyCode.KeypadEquals.documentation: The = key on the keypad cluster.

@roblox/enum/KeyCode.F13.documentation: The F13 key. Only present on certain keyboards.

@roblox/enum/KeyCode.F14.documentation: The F14 key. Only present on certain keyboards.

@roblox/enum/KeyCode.F15.documentation: The F15 key. Only present on certain keyboards.

@roblox/enum/KeyCode.NumLock.documentation: The Num Lock key on the keypad cluster.

@roblox/enum/KeyCode.LeftSuper.documentation: The left side Super key. Better known as the Windows key or Cmd key.

@roblox/enum/KeyCode.RightSuper.documentation: The right side Super key. Better known as the Windows key or Cmd key.

@roblox/enum/KeyCode.Euro.documentation: The € key. Only present on certain keyboards.

@roblox/enum/KeyCode.DPadLeft.documentation: Left arrow on a gamepad D-pad.

@roblox/enum/KeyCode.DPadRight.documentation: Right arrow on a gamepad D-pad.

@roblox/enum/KeyCode.DPadUp.documentation: Up arrow on a gamepad D-pad.

@roblox/enum/KeyCode.DPadDown.documentation: Down arrow on a gamepad D-pad.

@roblox/enum/KeyCode.Thumbstick1Up.documentation: Up vector on the gamepad primary thumbstick. Primarily used in the Input Action System.

@roblox/enum/KeyCode.Thumbstick1Down.documentation: Down vector on the gamepad primary thumbstick. Primarily used in the Input Action System.

@roblox/enum/KeyCode.Thumbstick1Left.documentation: Left vector on the gamepad primary thumbstick. Primarily used in the Input Action System.

@roblox/enum/KeyCode.Thumbstick1Right.documentation: Right vector on the gamepad primary thumbstick. Primarily used in the Input Action System.

@roblox/enum/KeyCode.Thumbstick2Up.documentation: Up vector on the gamepad secondary thumbstick. Primarily used in the Input Action System.

@roblox/enum/KeyCode.Thumbstick2Down.documentation: Down vector on the gamepad secondary thumbstick. Primarily used in the Input Action System.

@roblox/enum/KeyCode.Thumbstick2Left.documentation: Left vector on the gamepad secondary thumbstick. Primarily used in the Input Action System.

@roblox/enum/KeyCode.Thumbstick2Right.documentation: Right vector on the gamepad secondary thumbstick. Primarily used in the Input Action System.

@roblox/enum/KeyCode.MouseBackButton.documentation: Deprecated: This enum is deprecated and flagged for removal.

@roblox/enum/KeyCode.MouseNoButton.documentation: Deprecated: This enum is deprecated and flagged for removal.

@roblox/enum/KeyCode.MouseX.documentation: Deprecated: This enum is deprecated and flagged for removal.

@roblox/enum/KeyCode.MouseY.documentation: Deprecated: This enum is deprecated and flagged for removal.

@roblox/enum/KeyCode.MousePosition.documentation: The position of a mouse in the viewport. Primarily used in the Input Action System.

@roblox/enum/KeyCode.TouchPosition.documentation: The position of a touch in the viewport. Primarily used in the Input Action System.

@roblox/global/Enum.KeyCode.documentation: Byte keycodes that represent the key or button involved in user input.

@roblox/enum/TeleportType.ToPlace.documentation: The teleport destination is a place (no specific instance).

@roblox/enum/TeleportType.ToInstance.documentation: The teleport destination is an instance of a place.

@roblox/enum/TeleportType.ToReservedServ.documentation: The destination of the teleport is a reserved server (a place instance that is reserved for a select group of players).

@roblox/global/Enum.TeleportType.documentation: Determines the type of teleport destination for a TeleportService teleport call.

@roblox/enum/SurfaceType.Smooth.documentation: Adds no details on the surface.

@roblox/enum/SurfaceType.Glue.documentation: Adds an "X" pattern across the surface.

@roblox/enum/SurfaceType.Weld.documentation: Adds an "X" pattern across the surface.

@roblox/enum/SurfaceType.Studs.documentation: Adds square studs across the surface.

@roblox/enum/SurfaceType.Inlet.documentation: Adds square holes across the surface where studs would be.

@roblox/enum/SurfaceType.Universal.documentation: Adds a checker pattern to the surface using studs and inlets.

@roblox/enum/SurfaceType.Hinge.documentation: Adds a yellow hinge to the surface. Parts touching it stick to the surface, allowing for rotations using physics. This should not be used for future work and existing instances should be replaced with a HingeConstraint.

@roblox/enum/SurfaceType.Motor.documentation: Functioned identically to a hinge with the addition of a grey ring.

@roblox/enum/SurfaceType.SteppingMotor.documentation: Functioned identically to a motor. It may have functioned differently in the past, but that functionality is non-existent.

@roblox/enum/SurfaceType.SmoothNoOutline.documentation: Previously similar to Smooth with outlines but no longer relevant since outlines have been removed.

@roblox/global/Enum.SurfaceType.documentation: Used to determine how a surface should be displayed on a part and how automatic surface joints should behave.

@roblox/enum/RecommendationActionType.Ad.documentation: The user added a reaction to the item, such as a "like".

@roblox/enum/RecommendationActionType.Re.documentation: The user removed a reaction from the item.
The user created an abuse report of the item.

@roblox/enum/RecommendationActionType.Co.documentation: The user commented on the item.

@roblox/enum/RecommendationActionType.Pl.documentation: The user joined an experience through the item, or played a mini-game associated with the item.

@roblox/enum/RecommendationActionType.Pu.documentation: The user made a purchase from the item.

@roblox/enum/Font.Arial.documentation: Arial has been removed. Using it will map to the Arimo font family of the Font data type.

@roblox/enum/Font.ArialBold.documentation: ArialBold has been removed. Using it will map to the Arimo font family of the Font data type.

@roblox/enum/Font.Gotham.documentation: Gotham has been removed. Using it will map to the Montserrat font family of the Font data type.

@roblox/enum/Font.GothamMedium.documentation: GothamMedium has been removed. Using it will map to the Montserrat font family of the Font data type.

@roblox/enum/Font.GothamBold.documentation: GothamBold has been removed. Using it will map to the Montserrat font family of the Font data type.

@roblox/enum/Font.GothamBlack.documentation: GothamBlack has been removed. Using it will map to the Montserrat font family of the Font data type.

@roblox/enum/Font.Unknown.documentation: Set when the GUI object's font face is set to a Font that has no corresponding enum value.

@roblox/enum/CoreGuiType.PlayerList.documentation: Dynamically updated Players list, commonly used as a leaderboard.

@roblox/enum/CoreGuiType.All.documentation: Refers to all available core UI.

@roblox/enum/CoreGuiType.SelfView.documentation: A player's perspective or view of their own character.

@roblox/enum/CoreGuiType.Captures.documentation: A "capture" button along the right side of the screen.

@roblox/enum/CoreGuiType.AvatarSwitcher.documentation: The Avatar Switcher allows users to change their platform avatar.

@roblox/global/Enum.CoreGuiType.documentation: Represents all available CoreGui "types" such as the Backpack and text chat window.

@roblox/enum/DialogBehaviorType.SinglePl.documentation: Only one player can interact with this dialog at a time. The conversation between the player and dialog can be seen by all players.

@roblox/enum/DialogBehaviorType.Multiple.documentation: Multiple players can simultaneously interact with this dialog. The conversation between the player and the dialog cannot be seen by other players.

@roblox/global/Enum.DialogBehaviorType.documentation: Controls whether multiple people can use this dialog, or only one person at a time can use it.

@roblox/enum/ApplyStrokeMode.Contextual.documentation: The stroke is applied to the parent UI element's text.

@roblox/enum/ApplyStrokeMode.Border.documentation: The stroke is applied to the parent UI element's border.

@roblox/global/Enum.ApplyStrokeMode.documentation: Used by UIStroke.ApplyStrokeMode to determine where to apply the stroke.

@roblox/enum/UIDragDetectorDragSpace.Par.documentation: Designates the input and return values' space as the local space of the detector's parent GuiObject.

@roblox/enum/UIDragDetectorDragSpace.Lay.documentation: Designates the input and return values' space as that of the LayerCollector.

@roblox/enum/UIDragDetectorDragSpace.Ref.documentation: Designates the input and return values' space as that of the ReferenceUIInstance. For DragRelativity and DragUDim2 purposes, the (0, 0) origin is the absolute center position of the ReferenceUIInstance. If ReferenceUIInstance is not nil, this will behave the same as Parent.

@roblox/global/Enum.UIDragDetectorDragSp.documentation: Used with DragDetector to set the paradigm which defines the space of inputs/outputs from a custom drag function.

@roblox/enum/UIDragDetectorResponseStyle.documentation: Move by the Offset values of the detector's parent's GuiObject.Position value.
Move by the Scale values of the detector's parent's GuiObject.Position value.

The UI element will not move at all, but the Offset values of the detector's DragUDim2 will still be updated and the detector's events will still fire, allowing you to respond to drag manipulation however you'd like.

The UI element will not move at all, but the Scale values of the detector's DragUDim2 will still be updated and the detector's events will still fire, allowing you to respond to drag manipulation however you'd like.

@roblox/global/Enum.UIDragDetectorRespon.documentation: Describes how the clicked GuiObject will be treated once the desired motion has been calculated.

@roblox/enum/SignalBehavior.Default.documentation: The default behavior; currently equivalent to Immediate but this will eventually change to Deferred.

@roblox/enum/SignalBehavior.Immediate.documentation: Event handlers are resumed immediately when the event occurs.

@roblox/enum/SignalBehavior.Deferred.documentation: All events are deferred and their handlers resumed at specific resumptions points each frame.

@roblox/enum/SignalBehavior.AncestryDefe.documentation: Equivalent to Deferred but only for events triggered by changes in ancestry.

@roblox/global/Enum.SignalBehavior.documentation: Determines when the engine resumes event handlers.

@roblox/enum/TopBottom.Top.documentation: The object is above its parent.

@roblox/enum/TopBottom.Center.documentation: The object is centered around the center of its parent.

@roblox/enum/TopBottom.Bottom.documentation: The object is below its parent.

@roblox/global/Enum.TopBottom.documentation: Sets where the object is on the side of its parent.

@roblox/enum/ReceiptDecision.NotProcesse.documentation: The receipt has not been processed yet. Returning this value keeps the receipt unresolved so it will be delivered again on the next opportunity, such as when the user rejoins a server.

@roblox/enum/ReceiptDecision.Processed.documentation: The receipt has been processed and all benefits have been granted. The receipt is marked as complete and will not be delivered again.

@roblox/global/Enum.ReceiptDecision.documentation: ReceiptDecision works with MarketplaceService to indicate the acknowledgement of receipts.

@roblox/global/Enum.AnalyticsCustomField.documentation: Used to form a dictionary of custom fields to provide breakdowns in Roblox-provided charts.

@roblox/enum/WrapTargetDebugMode.None.documentation: This debug rendering mode does nothing, and this is the default value.

@roblox/enum/WrapTargetDebugMode.TargetC.documentation: This debug mode shows the original cage mesh as it was created.
This debug mode shows corresponding cage mesh compressed by clothing layers above it. This debug mode is intended to validate that the compression algorithm and corresponding cages work as intended.
This debug mode shows the resulting cage mesh for the corresponding Wrap Instance. This debug mode is intended to validate that the final deformed cage looks as intended.

@roblox/enum/WrapTargetDebugMode.TargetL.documentation: The same as TargetCageOriginal but affects all WrapTargets that belong to the Wrap Deformer simultaneously. It doesn't matter which particular WrapTarget you enable this debug visualization option.
The same as TargetCageCompressed but affects all WrapTargets that belong to the Wrap Deformer simultaneously. It doesn't matter which particular WrapTarget you enable this debug visualization option.
The same as TargetCageInterface but affects all WrapTargets that belong to the Wrap Deformer simultaneously. It doesn't matter which particular WrapTarget you enable this debug visualization option.

@roblox/enum/WrapTargetDebugMode.Rbf.documentation: This debug mode visualizes the internal RBF solver state. You can estimate the wrap deformer expected behavior by looking at this state. All renderable mesh vertices move from a "big sphere" to a "small sphere" along a corresponding line connecting two spheres.

@roblox/global/Enum.WrapTargetDebugMode.documentation: The Studio-only property for quickly visualizing and debugging meshes with only outer cages.

@roblox/enum/InOut.Edge.documentation: The object is located along an edge of its parent.

@roblox/enum/InOut.Inset.documentation: The object's located is inset from its parent's location.

@roblox/enum/InOut.Center.documentation: The object's location is centered on it's parent.

@roblox/global/Enum.InOut.documentation: The InOut Enum is used to set where the object is on the side of its parent.

@roblox/enum/PlayerChatType.All.documentation: A global message that everyone can receive.

@roblox/enum/PlayerChatType.Team.documentation: A team message only players in the same team can receive.

@roblox/enum/PlayerChatType.Whisper.documentation: A whispered message only the person it's whispered to can receive.

@roblox/global/Enum.PlayerChatType.documentation: Determines the style of a chat message.

@roblox/enum/UserInputType.MouseMovement.documentation: Movement of the mouse. Fires changed events each time the player's cursor position changes and when the move enters/leaves the game window.

@roblox/enum/UserInputType.Touch.documentation: A tap on the screen from a mobile device.

@roblox/enum/UserInputType.Focus.documentation: The client regaining focus of the Roblox window.

@roblox/enum/UserInputType.Accelerometer.documentation: The accelerometer of a mobile device.

@roblox/enum/UserInputType.Gyro.documentation: The Gyroscope of a mobile device.

@roblox/enum/UserInputType.Gamepad1.documentation: Input from the 1st plugged in Gamepad.

@roblox/enum/UserInputType.Gamepad2.documentation: Input from the 2nd plugged in Gamepad.

@roblox/enum/UserInputType.Gamepad3.documentation: Input from the 3rd plugged in Gamepad.

@roblox/enum/UserInputType.Gamepad4.documentation: Input from the 4th plugged in Gamepad.

@roblox/enum/UserInputType.Gamepad5.documentation: Input from the 5th plugged in Gamepad.

@roblox/enum/UserInputType.Gamepad6.documentation: Input from the 6th plugged in Gamepad.

@roblox/enum/UserInputType.Gamepad7.documentation: Input from the 7th plugged in Gamepad.

@roblox/enum/UserInputType.Gamepad8.documentation: Input from the 8th plugged in Gamepad.

@roblox/enum/UserInputType.TextInput.documentation: Input of Text into a text-based GuiObject. Normally this is only a TextBox.

@roblox/enum/UserInputType.InputMethod.documentation: Text input from an input method editor (IME). InputObjects with this type aren't currently fired.

@roblox/global/Enum.UserInputType.documentation: Describes the type of a user input event.

@roblox/enum/ChatMode.Menu.documentation: The player is restricted to chatting via a menu of chat messages.

@roblox/enum/ChatMode.TextAndMenu.documentation: A player can chat via custom text messages and a menu of chat messages.

@roblox/enum/TouchMovementMode.Thumbstic.documentation: Change the movement controller to the classic thumbstick.

@roblox/enum/TouchMovementMode.DPad.documentation: Change the movement controller to the DPad.

@roblox/enum/TouchMovementMode.Thumbpad.documentation: Change the movement controller to the thumbpad.

@roblox/enum/TouchMovementMode.ClickToMo.documentation: Change the movement controller to click to move.

@roblox/enum/TouchMovementMode.DynamicTh.documentation: Change the movement controller to the dynamic thumbstick.

@roblox/global/Enum.TouchMovementMode.documentation: The movement mode used by a client with a TouchEnabled device.

@roblox/global/Enum.LineJoinMode.documentation: This enum is used by UIStroke.LineJoinMode to determine how corners are interpreted.

@roblox/enum/SelectionBehavior.Escape.documentation: Prioritizes GuiObjects within the same SelectionGroup but allows the selection to move to other outside GuiObjects if no suitable button is found.

@roblox/enum/SelectionBehavior.Stop.documentation: Constrains gamepad selection to the SelectionGroup.

@roblox/global/Enum.SelectionBehavior.documentation: Customization options for gamepad selection when GuiBase2d.SelectionGroup is true.

@roblox/enum/ComputerMovementMode.Keyboa.documentation: The player's character is controlled using the keyboard and mouse.

@roblox/enum/ComputerMovementMode.ClickT.documentation: The player can right-click in the game world and their character will move there. In addition, the player can also control their character with their mouse and keyboard.

@roblox/global/Enum.ComputerMovementMode.documentation: The computer movement type in-use by the client.

@roblox/enum/InputType.NoInput.documentation: Behaves like a weld and does nothing.

@roblox/enum/InputType.Constant.documentation: Rotate at a constant velocity of BasePart ParamB.

@roblox/enum/InputType.Sin.documentation: Rotate at a velocity of: ParamA * math.sin(workspace.DistributedGameTime * ParamB), where BasePart ParamA determines the maximum speed at which the part spins, and BasePart ParamB determines how frequently it changes direction.

@roblox/global/Enum.InputType.documentation: The InputType Enum controls the SurfaceInputs of Part.

@roblox/enum/FinishRecordingOperation.Ca.documentation: Cancels the recording, automatically undoing any work in progress.

@roblox/enum/FinishRecordingOperation.Ap.documentation: Commits the recorded work and merges with the previous recording if possible.

@roblox/enum/FluidFidelity.Automatic.documentation: Let the physics engine select the geometric representation for aerodynamic force and torque calculations.

@roblox/enum/FluidFidelity.UseCollisionG.documentation: Use the current collision geometry specified by TriangleMeshPart.CollisionFidelity for aerodynamic force and torque calculations .

@roblox/enum/FluidFidelity.UsePreciseGeo.documentation: Force the engine to compute aerodynamic forces and torques using a more precise geometry representation based on the original mesh. This option may increase join and replication time if used on a large scale.

@roblox/global/Enum.FluidFidelity.documentation: Determines the geometric representation used to compute aerodynamic forces.

@roblox/global/Enum.BodyPartR15.documentation: BodyPartR15 is an enum with entries for each of the 15 body parts of an R15 character (plus an entry for the HumanoidRootPart).

@roblox/global/Enum.Button.documentation: One of the buttons used by Controller.

@roblox/enum/ScrollingDirection.X.documentation: The canvas can only be scrolled along the X axis.

@roblox/enum/ScrollingDirection.Y.documentation: The canvas can only be scrolled along the Y axis.

@roblox/enum/ScrollingDirection.XY.documentation: The canvas can be scrolled along both the X and Y axes.

@roblox/global/Enum.ScrollingDirection.documentation: This enum is used by ScrollingFrame.ScrollingDirection to specify the direction(s) in which scrolling is allowed.

@roblox/enum/ButtonStyle.Custom.documentation: The button will respect the GuiObject.BorderColor3 and GuiObject.BackgroundColor3 properties.

@roblox/enum/ButtonStyle.RobloxButtonDef.documentation: A black background with a red border, and rounded corners.

@roblox/enum/ButtonStyle.RobloxButton.documentation: A black background with a grey border, and rounded corners.

@roblox/enum/ButtonStyle.RobloxRoundButt.documentation: A grey background with rounded corners, and a slight drop shadow.

@roblox/enum/ButtonStyle.RobloxRoundDefa.documentation: A blue background with rounded corners, and a slight drop shadow.

@roblox/enum/ButtonStyle.RobloxRoundDrop.documentation: A white background with a thin grey border, rounded corners, and a slight drop shadow.

@roblox/global/Enum.ButtonStyle.documentation: Used by GuiButton.Style to set a special hardcoded appearance.

@roblox/enum/ModelStreamingBehavior.Lega.documentation: Models are sent when their parent is sent, typically during player join. Models are never streamed out unless an ancestor of the model is streamed out.

@roblox/enum/ModelStreamingBehavior.Impr.documentation: Models are never sent during player join. See model streaming controls for detailed behavioral notes.

@roblox/global/Enum.ModelStreamingBehavi.documentation: Controls how Models are sent to clients in experiences with instance streaming enabled.

@roblox/enum/CompressionAlgorithm.Zstd.documentation: Used to perform compression using Zstandard compression, also known as zstd.

@roblox/global/Enum.CompressionAlgorithm.documentation: A compression algorithm to use in EncodingService methods.

@roblox/global/Enum.RotationOrder.documentation: The order of rotation axes used for Euler angles encoding of rotations.

@roblox/enum/InitialDockState.Top.documentation: The widget will appear docked above the game screen.

@roblox/enum/InitialDockState.Bottom.documentation: The widget will appear docked below the game screen.

@roblox/enum/InitialDockState.Left.documentation: The widget will appear docked to the left of the game screen.

@roblox/enum/InitialDockState.Right.documentation: The widget will appear docked to the right of the game screen.

@roblox/enum/InitialDockState.Float.documentation: The widget will not be docked to any side of the game screen, and instead can be freely dragged around.

@roblox/global/Enum.InitialDockState.documentation: Describes the initial docking state of a DockWidgetPluginGui.

@roblox/enum/PreferredTextSize.Medium.documentation: The player prefers default text size.

@roblox/enum/PreferredTextSize.Large.documentation: The player prefers text size slightly increased beyond default.

@roblox/enum/PreferredTextSize.Larger.documentation: The player prefers text size moderately increased beyond default.

@roblox/enum/PreferredTextSize.Largest.documentation: The player prefers text size considerably increased beyond default.

@roblox/global/Enum.PreferredTextSize.documentation: This enum is used with GuiService.PreferredTextSize to indicate the player's preferred text size.

@roblox/enum/PlayerExitReason.Unknown.documentation: Catch-all for all other disconnect reasons.

@roblox/enum/PlayerExitReason.PlatformKi.documentation: User was kicked by Roblox systems, such as being blocked while in a Private Server.

@roblox/global/Enum.PlayerExitReason.documentation: An enum that specifies the reason for Players.PlayerRemoving signal.

@roblox/enum/TextChatMessageStatus.Unkno.documentation: Generic failed status for any other TextChannel:SendAsync() failures.

@roblox/enum/TextChatMessageStatus.TextF.documentation: Text filter failed to process the message.

@roblox/enum/TextChatMessageStatus.Flood.documentation: Message is from a user sending messages too frequently.

@roblox/enum/TextChatMessageStatus.Inval.documentation: Message can't be sent because of the user's chat privacy settings.
Message's TextSource is either not in the intended TextChannel or TextSource.CanSend is false.

@roblox/enum/AdAvailabilityResult.IsAvai.documentation: An ad is available to show the user.

@roblox/enum/AdAvailabilityResult.Device.documentation: The device is ineligible to receive ads.

@roblox/enum/AdAvailabilityResult.Experi.documentation: The experience is ineligible to receive ads. Check if its eligibility has been revoked.

@roblox/enum/AdAvailabilityResult.Intern.documentation: An unspecified internal error occurred. Try fetching the ad again.

@roblox/enum/AdAvailabilityResult.NoFill.documentation: There are no ads available to fill your ad request. You might have hit the ad frequency limit.

@roblox/enum/AdAvailabilityResult.Player.documentation: The user is ineligible to receive ads during this session. The user might be under 13 or located in a blocked region.

@roblox/enum/AdAvailabilityResult.Publis.documentation: The publisher is ineligible to receive ads because they have not met the publisher eligibility requirements.

@roblox/enum/ThumbnailType.HeadShot.documentation: The returned thumbnail shows just the headshot (head and up) of the user's avatar.

@roblox/enum/ThumbnailType.AvatarBust.documentation: The returned thumbnail shows the bust (chest up) of the user's avatar.

@roblox/enum/ThumbnailType.AvatarThumbna.documentation: The returned thumbnail shows the entire body of the user's avatar.

@roblox/enum/VirtualCursorMode.Default.documentation: The Virtual Cursor is in the default state.

@roblox/global/Enum.VirtualCursorMode.documentation: Enables Virtual Cursor mode within an experience.

@roblox/enum/ParticleFlipbookMode.Loop.documentation: Continuously play through all frames, starting back at the first frame after playing the last.

@roblox/enum/ParticleFlipbookMode.OneSho.documentation: Play through the animation only once across the particle's lifetime. With this setting, the ParticleEmitter.FlipbookFramerate property doesn't apply; instead, the framerate is determined by the particle's ParticleEmitter.Lifetime divided evenly by the number of frames in the animation. OneShot animations are useful for clear non-repeating animations, such as an explosion that creates a puff of smoke and then fades out.

@roblox/enum/ParticleFlipbookMode.PingPo.documentation: Play from the first to the last frame, then in reverse from the last to the first, repeating throughout the ParticleEmitter.Lifetime of the particle.

@roblox/enum/ParticleFlipbookMode.Random.documentation: Play the frames in a random order, blending/crossfading from one frame to the next. This can be useful for organic particle textures at low framerates, such as stars slowly twinkling between subtly different shapes.

@roblox/global/Enum.ParticleFlipbookMode.documentation: Determines the type of the flipbook animation.

@roblox/enum/MoveState.Coasting.documentation: Skateboard is coasting (not actively speeding up / being pushed).

@roblox/enum/MoveState.Stopping.documentation: Skateboard is stopping, but still moving.

@roblox/enum/FriendRequestEvent.Issue.documentation: A player invokes (sends) a friend request.

@roblox/enum/FriendRequestEvent.Revoke.documentation: A player revokes (cancels) a previously invoked (sent) friend request.

@roblox/enum/FriendRequestEvent.Accept.documentation: A player accepts a friend request.

@roblox/enum/FriendRequestEvent.Deny.documentation: A player denies a friend request.

@roblox/enum/SwipeDirection.None.documentation: The user did not swipe in a certain direction.

@roblox/global/Enum.SwipeDirection.documentation: The direction that a user is swiping on their touch screen.

@roblox/enum/RollOffMode.Inverse.documentation: Volume attenuates from Sound.RollOffMinDistance in an inverse manner, mirroring how sounds attenuate in the real world. This is done through Sound.RollOffMinDistance/distance, where distance is the Vector3.Magnitude between the audio source and the audio listener.

@roblox/enum/RollOffMode.Linear.documentation: Volume attenuates between Sound.RollOffMinDistance and Sound.RollOffMaxDistance with a linear relationship. This is done through (Sound.RollOffMaxDistance/distance)/(Sound.RollOffMaxDistance-Sound.RollOffMinDistance), where distance is the Vector3.Magnitude between the audio source and the audio listener.

@roblox/enum/RollOffMode.LinearSquare.documentation: Volume attenuates between Sound.RollOffMinDistance and Sound.RollOffMaxDistance with a linear squared relationship. This is done through squaring Linear.

@roblox/enum/RollOffMode.InverseTapered.documentation: A hybrid model which follows the Inverse model when close to Sound.RollOffMinDistance and the LinearSquare model when close to Sound.RollOffMaxDistance. This is done by taking the lesser of Inverse and LinearSquare.

@roblox/global/Enum.RollOffMode.documentation: How Sounds parented to a BasePart or Attachment attenuate (fade out) as the distance between the listener and the parent increases.

@roblox/enum/ActivePayerStatus.Never.documentation: The player has not made a qualifying purchase in the experience.

@roblox/enum/ActivePayerStatus.Lapsed.documentation: The player has previously spent in the experience but is not currently an active payer.

@roblox/enum/ActivePayerStatus.Casual50P.documentation: The player is in the casual payer bucket for the experience.

@roblox/enum/ActivePayerStatus.Intermedi.documentation: The player is in the intermediate payer bucket for the experience.

@roblox/enum/ActivePayerStatus.Top15Perc.documentation: The player is in the top payer bucket for the experience.

@roblox/global/Enum.ActivePayerStatus.documentation: Describes a player's payer status bucket for the current experience.

@roblox/enum/TonemapperPreset.Default.documentation: Sets the tone mapper to use the post‑2019 Roblox appearance which provides vivid colors and high contrasts.

@roblox/enum/TonemapperPreset.Retro.documentation: Sets the tone mapper to imitate the pre‑2019 Roblox appearance. Colors look less saturated and there is less contrast between them.

@roblox/enum/DialogTone.Neutral.documentation: Causes the dialog to have a blue bar on its left-hand side.

@roblox/enum/DialogTone.Friendly.documentation: Causes the dialog to have a green bar on its left-hand side.

@roblox/enum/DialogTone.Enemy.documentation: Causes the dialog to have a red bar on its left-hand side.

@roblox/global/Enum.DialogTone.documentation: Sets the Dialog.Tone of a Dialog object, which influences how the dialog appears.

@roblox/enum/MouseBehavior.Default.documentation: The mouse moves freely around the user's screen.

@roblox/enum/MouseBehavior.LockCenter.documentation: The mouse is locked and cannot move from the center of the user's screen.

@roblox/enum/MouseBehavior.LockCurrentPo.documentation: The mouse is locked and cannot move from its current position on the user's screen at the time of locking.

@roblox/enum/ScreenInsets.None.documentation: No insets are added to the fullscreen area. This mode may result in UI that is obscured or completely hidden by device notches and cutouts, so you should only use it for a ScreenGui that contains non‑interactive content like background images.

@roblox/enum/ScreenInsets.DeviceSafeInse.documentation: Device safe area insets are added to the fullscreen area. The resulting area is guaranteed to not be occluded by any device screen cutouts such as the camera notch, although no inset is added for Roblox core UI elements like the top bar buttons. As a result, it's recommended that you use CoreUISafeInsets for a ScreenGui whose contents should remain unobscured by both device cutouts and core screen elements.

@roblox/enum/ScreenInsets.CoreUISafeInse.documentation: Core UI insets are added to the DeviceSafeInsets area, resulting in an area guaranteed to be unobscured by both device screen cutouts and Roblox core UI elements like the top bar buttons. This mode is recommended for any ScreenGui that contains interactive and/or important UI elements such as buttons and status messages.

@roblox/enum/ScreenInsets.TopbarSafeInse.documentation: Top bar safe area insets are added to the DeviceSafeInsets area, resulting in an area guaranteed to be unobscured by both device screen cutouts and Roblox core UI elements like the experience controls. Unlike CoreUISafeInsets, this area's position and size is dynamic and is limited to the space available within the top bar area itself, outside of CoreUISafeInsets. See the GuiService.TopbarInset property which represents the absolute size and position of the unobstructed area within the top bar space.

@roblox/global/Enum.ScreenInsets.documentation: Insets associated with various screen safe areas.

@roblox/enum/PlayerPlatformSpenderStatus.documentation: The player is an active platform spender.
The player is not an active platform spender, including players who have never spent.

@roblox/global/Enum.PlayerPlatformSpende.documentation: Describes a player's platform-wide spender status bucket.

@roblox/enum/MeshPartDetailLevel.Distanc.documentation: Select level of detail based on distance (default behavior as in game).

@roblox/global/Enum.MeshPartDetailLevel.documentation: The level of detail of MeshParts displayed in Studio.

@roblox/enum/UIDragSpeedAxisMapping.XY.documentation: Default setting for a detector's UIDragSpeedAxisMapping where the X and Y axis speeds are based off the X and Y Scale/Offset values respectively.

@roblox/enum/UIDragSpeedAxisMapping.XX.documentation: Both the X and Y axis speeds are based off the X axis for Scale, while the Offset values still apply to their respective axis.

@roblox/enum/UIDragSpeedAxisMapping.YY.documentation: Both the X and Y axis speeds are based off the Y axis for Scale, while the Offset values still apply to their respective axis.

@roblox/global/Enum.UIDragSpeedAxisMappi.documentation: Used with UIDragDetector.UIDragSpeedAxisMapping to determine the X/Y dimension dragging speeds.

@roblox/enum/FriendStatus.Unknown.documentation: The friend status of two players is unknown.

@roblox/enum/FriendStatus.FriendRequestS.documentation: At least one of two players has sent a friend request to the other player.

@roblox/enum/FriendStatus.FriendRequestR.documentation: At least one of two players has received a friend request sent by the other player.

@roblox/enum/ItemLineAlignment.Automatic.documentation: Aligns the siblings of the UIListLayout or the specific UIFlexItem parent to the layout's HorizontalAlignment or VerticalAlignment, depending on its FillDirection. If HorizontalFlex or VerticalFlex is enabled for the UIListLayout cross‑direction, Stretch will be used for that direction.

@roblox/enum/ItemLineAlignment.Start.documentation: Aligns the siblings of the UIListLayout or the specific UIFlexItem parent to the line's top in a horizontal fill or the line's left in a vertical fill.

@roblox/enum/ItemLineAlignment.Center.documentation: Aligns the siblings of the UIListLayout or the specific UIFlexItem parent to the line's center in either a horizontal or vertical fill.

@roblox/enum/ItemLineAlignment.End.documentation: Aligns the siblings of the UIListLayout or the specific UIFlexItem parent to the line's bottom in a horizontal fill or the line's right in a vertical fill.

@roblox/enum/ItemLineAlignment.Stretch.documentation: Stretches the siblings of the UIListLayout or the specific UIFlexItem parent to fill the entire cross‑direction of the line in either a horizontal or vertical fill.

@roblox/global/Enum.ItemLineAlignment.documentation: Used for UIListLayout.ItemLineAlignment and UIFlexItem.ItemLineAlignment in a flex layout to define the cross-directional alignment of siblings or the parent within a line.

@roblox/enum/WhenUserFirstPlayed.Days0To.documentation: The player first played the experience within the last 30 days.

@roblox/enum/WhenUserFirstPlayed.Days31T.documentation: The player first played the experience between 31 and 90 days ago.

@roblox/enum/WhenUserFirstPlayed.Days91T.documentation: The player first played the experience between 91 and 180 days ago.

@roblox/enum/WhenUserFirstPlayed.Days181.documentation: The player first played the experience between 181 and 365 days ago.

@roblox/enum/WhenUserFirstPlayed.Days366.documentation: The player first played the experience more than 365 days ago.

@roblox/global/Enum.WhenUserFirstPlayed.documentation: Describes when a player first played the current experience, represented as a bucket.

@roblox/global/Enum.PlayerActions.documentation: References a movement action taken by a player.

@roblox/enum/PlayerCharacterDestroyBehav.documentation: Automatic Destroy() calls on character replacement and player removal are disabled.
The engine automatically calls Destroy() on old characters when they are replaced (for example, on respawn) and on Player objects when players leave.

@roblox/global/Enum.PlayerCharacterDestr.documentation: Controls destruction behavior when a player character is removed.

@roblox/global/Enum.Status.documentation:
Deprecated: This enum is deprecated as it was only used by deprecated methods and events. It should not be used in new work.
This enum was used with the unfinished Status library.

@roblox/global/Enum.KeywordFilterType.documentation: Determines if a filter is 'inclusive' or 'exclusive'.

@roblox/enum/CompositeValueCurveType.Col.documentation: The CompositeValueCurve will animate children of type FloatCurve named "R", "G", and "B" to animate the corresponding components of the Color3 value returned by the method CompositeValueCurve:GetValueAtTime().

The CompositeValueCurve will animate children of type FloatCurve named "H", "S", and "V" to animate hue, saturation, and value of a color that will be converted to RGB before returning a Color3 value from the method CompositeValueCurve:GetValueAtTime().

@roblox/enum/CompositeValueCurveType.Num.documentation: The CompositeValueCurve will animate children of type FloatCurve named "Min" and "Max" to animate the corresponding components of the NumberRange value returned by the method CompositeValueCurve:GetValueAtTime().

@roblox/enum/CompositeValueCurveType.Rec.documentation: The CompositeValueCurve will animate children of type FloatCurve named "MinX", "MaxX", "MinY", and "MaxY" to animate the corresponding components of the Rect value returned by the method CompositeValueCurve:GetValueAtTime().

@roblox/enum/CompositeValueCurveType.UDi.documentation: The CompositeValueCurve will animate children of type FloatCurve named "Scale" and "Offset" to animate the corresponding components of the UDim value returned by the method CompositeValueCurve:GetValueAtTime().

The CompositeValueCurve will animate children of type FloatCurve named "ScaleX", "OffsetX", "ScaleY", and "OffsetY" to animate the corresponding components of the UDim2 value returned by the method CompositeValueCurve:GetValueAtTime().

@roblox/enum/CompositeValueCurveType.Vec.documentation: The CompositeValueCurve will animate children of type FloatCurve named "X" and "Y" to animate the corresponding components of the Vector2 value returned by the method CompositeValueCurve:GetValueAtTime().

The CompositeValueCurve will animate children of type FloatCurve named "X", "Y", and "Z" to animate the corresponding components of the Vector3 value returned by the method CompositeValueCurve:GetValueAtTime().

@roblox/global/Enum.CompositeValueCurveT.documentation: Describes the type of value animated by a CompositeValueCurve.

@roblox/enum/FunctionalTestResult.Warnin.documentation: The test run is potentially unstable.

@roblox/global/Enum.FunctionalTestResult.documentation: Status of a single functional test run.

@roblox/enum/TouchCameraMovementMode.Def.documentation: Default mode used by Roblox core scripts.

@roblox/enum/TouchCameraMovementMode.Cla.documentation: Default mode used by Roblox core scripts.

@roblox/enum/TouchCameraMovementMode.Fol.documentation: Camera moves with the subject and rotates to keep the subject in the center.

@roblox/enum/TouchCameraMovementMode.Orb.documentation: The camera locks at a certain angle. Once it's set, players can rotate the camera, but it will always maintain a consistent angle to the ground.

@roblox/global/Enum.TouchCameraMovementM.documentation: Changes the touch camera movement mode currently in-use by the client using a TouchEnabled device.

@roblox/enum/DeviceType.Unknown.documentation: The client is an unknown device.

@roblox/enum/DeviceType.Desktop.documentation: The client is a desktop device.

@roblox/enum/DeviceType.Tablet.documentation: The client is a tablet device.

@roblox/enum/DeviceType.Phone.documentation: The client is a phone device.

@roblox/enum/DragDetectorDragStyle.Trans.documentation: 1D motion along the detector's Axis, by default the world Y axis.
2D motion in the plane perpendicular to the detector's Axis, by default the world XZ plane.
2D motion in the plane perpendicular to the detector's Axis and, when the modifier is active, 1D motion along the detector's Axis.
1D motion along the detector's Axis and, when the modifier is active, 2D motion in the plane perpendicular to the detector's Axis.
2D motion in the plane perpendicular to the camera's view. In this mode, the plane is constantly updated, even while dragging, and will always face the camera's current view.

@roblox/enum/DragDetectorDragStyle.Rotat.documentation: Rotation about the detector's Axis, by default the world Y axis.
Trackball rotation, further customized through the TrackballRadialPullFactor and TrackballRollFactor properties.

@roblox/enum/DragDetectorDragStyle.Scrip.documentation: Calculates desired motion via a custom function provided through SetDragStyleFunction().

@roblox/enum/DragDetectorDragStyle.BestF.documentation: TranslatePlaneOrLine for mouse and gamepad; TranslatePlane for touch; 6DOF for VR.

@roblox/global/Enum.DragDetectorDragStyl.documentation: Used with DragDetector as the paradigm to generate proposed motion, given a stream of cursor rays.

@roblox/enum/AnalyticsEconomyTransaction.documentation: Represents a source of currency purchased via Robux, for example in-experience "gold" purchased for Robux.
Purchases within a shop, for example in-experience "coins" used to buy an item within the experience.
Currency earned or paid through gameplay, for example in-experience "gold" earned from winning a match.
Purchase with direct context to a reward, for example in-experience "gold" used to purchase an extra life.
Time-based reward, for example in-experience "gold" rewarded for logging in daily.
Transaction related to onboarding, for example in-experience "gold" rewarded for completing the tutorial.

@roblox/enum/VRTouchpadMode.Touch.documentation: The touchpad is treated as ButtonB if it is the left touchpad, or ButtonA if it is the right touchpad.

@roblox/enum/VRTouchpadMode.VirtualThumb.documentation: The touchpad will function as a gamepad joystick.

@roblox/enum/VRTouchpadMode.ABXY.documentation: The touchpad will function as a means of inputting the standard ABXY gamepad input, dividing it up into 4 diagonal pie slices.

@roblox/global/Enum.VRTouchpadMode.documentation: Used to identify the behavior of a specified VR touchpad.

@roblox/enum/KeyInterpolationMode.Consta.documentation: The segment starting at this key will constantly evaluate to the value set at this key.

@roblox/enum/KeyInterpolationMode.Linear.documentation: The segment starting at this key will evaluate using a linear interpolation at this key and the value at the next key.

@roblox/enum/KeyInterpolationMode.Cubic.documentation: The segment starting at this key will evaluate using cubic interpolation of this key value using its right tangent and the next key value and its left tangent.

@roblox/global/Enum.KeyInterpolationMode.documentation: Describes the interpolation method between two keys.

@roblox/enum/ForceLimitMode.Magnitude.documentation: A single number is used to specify the magnitude of the maximum constraint force. The constraint will ensure that the force it applies will have a magnitude that is less than this limit.

@roblox/enum/ForceLimitMode.PerAxis.documentation: A vector is used to specify the maximum force value along each axis of a given reference frame. The constraint will ensure that each component of the force will have an absolute value that's less than the corresponding vector entry.

@roblox/global/Enum.ForceLimitMode.documentation: The ForceLimitMode enum determines how the maximum force for a constraint is specified and how that limit is enforced by the constraint.

@roblox/enum/StrokeSizingMode.ScaledSize.documentation: Thickness is relative to minimum parent width or height. If stroke is on text, thickness is relative to font size.

@roblox/global/Enum.StrokeSizingMode.documentation: Used by UIStroke.StrokeSizingMode to determine whether the stroke's Thickness will be measured in pixels or be relative to the parent.

@roblox/enum/MeshType.Head.documentation: The mesh is the default Humanoid head mesh.

@roblox/enum/MeshType.Torso.documentation: The mesh is the default Humanoid torso mesh.

@roblox/enum/MeshType.FileMesh.documentation: The mesh is determined by the Roblox mesh asset ID provided.

@roblox/enum/MeshType.Brick.documentation: The mesh is a brick (just like the shape of a default BasePart).

@roblox/enum/MeshType.RightAngleRamp.documentation:
Deprecated:
The mesh is a right angle ramp.

@roblox/global/Enum.MeshType.documentation: The MeshType Enum is used to set what type of mesh the SpecialMesh is.

@roblox/enum/FontStyle.Normal.documentation: The text renders normally with this font.

@roblox/enum/FontStyle.Italic.documentation: The text renders italic with this font.

@roblox/global/Enum.FontStyle.documentation: Describes whether a Font style is normal or italic.

@roblox/enum/GraphicsMode.Automatic.documentation: Roblox will automatically decide what graphics mode to use, depending on what best suits your device's specifications.

@roblox/enum/GraphicsMode.NoGraphics.documentation: Game will not be rendered, and instead a Diagnostics window is rendered on screen.

@roblox/global/Enum.GraphicsMode.documentation: Used to set the graphics API that Roblox uses to render the game.

@roblox/enum/UIDragDetectorDragStyle.Tra.documentation: 2D motion in the plane of the LayerCollector.

@roblox/enum/UIDragDetectorDragStyle.Rot.documentation: By default, rotation about the absolute center position of the detector's parent GuiObject. If ReferenceUIInstance is set, rotation happens about that instance's absolute center position.

@roblox/enum/UIDragDetectorDragStyle.Scr.documentation: Calculates desired motion via a custom function provided through SetDragStyleFunction().

@roblox/global/Enum.UIDragDetectorDragSt.documentation: Used with UIDragDetector as the paradigm to generate proposed motion, given a stream of input position vectors.

@roblox/enum/ProductPurchaseDecision.Not.documentation: The purchase request has been sent but not yet processed.

@roblox/enum/ProductPurchaseDecision.Pur.documentation: The purchase has been processed and granted to the user who initiated the purchase request.

@roblox/global/Enum.ProductPurchaseDecis.documentation: The ProductPurchaseDecisionEnum works with MarketplaceService to indicate the status of the sale of developer products.

@roblox/enum/VRScaling.World.documentation: Adjusts `Class.Camera.HeadScale' so that the world in VR is seen from the avatar's perspective.

@roblox/enum/AdFormat.RewardedVideo.documentation: The format of the rewarded video ad.

@roblox/global/Enum.BodyPart.documentation: The BodyPart Enum determines which BodyPart a CharacterMesh affects.

@roblox/global/Enum.VRTouchpad.documentation: Used to universally identify a VR touchpad that is used by either the left, or right hand.

@roblox/global/Enum.VideoSampleSize.documentation: The size of textures produced by VideoSampler.

@roblox/enum/SafeAreaCompatibility.None.documentation: Do not apply compatibility transformations to any descendants of the ScreenGui.

@roblox/enum/SafeAreaCompatibility.Fulls.documentation: If the total area of any descendant GuiObject within the ScreenGui (including any applied border or UIStroke) covers the device's safe area both horizontally and vertically, its background area will be expanded to cover the fullscreen area. This expansion does not affect the size or position of the descendant's content, except in the case of ImageLabel, ImageButton, or VideoFrame where the image/video is considered part of the background and will be expanded to fullscreen. Note that this option is intended to automatically improve the appearance of UI that was authored for screens without any cutouts. However, it's recommended that you avoid fullscreen extensions for new work; instead, use the ScreenInsets property to specify which insets should be respected for different ScreenGuis.

@roblox/global/Enum.SafeAreaCompatibilit.documentation: Describes how descendants of a ScreenGui adapt to screens with cutouts.

@roblox/enum/ModelLevelOfDetail.Streamin.documentation: A lower resolution "imposter" mesh (colored, coarse mesh that wraps around all child parts of the model) renders outside the streaming radius.

@roblox/enum/ModelLevelOfDetail.Disabled.documentation: A lower resolution mesh will not be displayed.

@roblox/enum/ModelLevelOfDetail.SLIM.documentation: A Scalable Lightweight Interactive Model, or SLIM, model (a composite of all child parts of the model) renders at progressively lower resolutions at distances based on the streaming radius. Greatly improves visual quality over StreamingMesh.

@roblox/global/Enum.ModelLevelOfDetail.documentation: Controls the level of detail for Models in experiences with instance streaming enabled.

@roblox/enum/AutomaticSize.X.documentation: Automatically resize element along the X axis to fit child contents.

@roblox/enum/AutomaticSize.Y.documentation: Automatically resize element along the Y axis to fit child contents. Text objects will only resize along the Y axis if their TextWrapped property is enabled.

@roblox/enum/AutomaticSize.XY.documentation: Automatically resize element along the X and Y axes to fit child contents.

@roblox/global/Enum.AutomaticSize.documentation: UI objects with AutomaticSize enabled will increase in size up to maximum size allowed by the parent (if there is one) and no smaller than the Size property bounds.

@roblox/enum/AudioChannelLayout.Mono.documentation: Monaural audio streams contain only one Center channel.

@roblox/enum/AudioChannelLayout.Stereo.documentation: Stereophonic audio streams consist of two channels: Left and Right.

@roblox/enum/AudioChannelLayout.Quad.documentation: Quadrophonic audio streams consist of four channels: Left, Right, BackLeft, and BackRight. Quadrophonic streams can encode forward/backward spatial information that stereo streams might struggle with.

@roblox/enum/AudioChannelLayout.Surround.documentation: Surround sound audio streams consist of five channels: Left, Right, Center, BackLeft, and BackRight. Surround sound streams encode spatial information with better resolution front and center.

5.1 surround sound consists of six channels: Left, Right, Center, BackLeft, BackRight, and a Sub (subsonic) low‑frequency channel. 5.1 surround sound benefits from low frequencies being less directional in order to encode higher resolution spatial information versus simple 5‑channel surround sound.

7.1 surround sound consists of eight channels: Left, Right, Center, SurroundLeft, SurroundRight, BackLeft, BackRight, and a Sub (subsonic) low‑frequency channel. 7.1 surround sound is an improvement over 5.1 surround sound, offering better spatial resolution directly to the left and right as well.

7.1.4 surround sound consists of twelve channels: Left, Right, Center, SurroundLeft, SurroundRight, BackLeft, BackRight, Sub, TopLeft, TopRight, TopBackLeft, and TopBackRight. 7.1.4 is the only currently supported channel layout that encodes height information.

@roblox/global/Enum.AudioChannelLayout.documentation: Describes the channel layout of an audio stream.

@roblox/enum/ChatVersion.TextChatService.documentation: Enables TextChatService chat and prevents legacy chat system behavior.

@roblox/global/Enum.ChatVersion.documentation: Determines whether TextChatService should be fully enabled or to allow the legacy system.

@roblox/enum/InputActionType.Bool.documentation: The InputAction will receive boolean values from button inputs, for example true/false on press/release from inputs such as KeyCode.ButtonA or KeyCode.E. This setting also exposes the UIButton property on child InputBindings, allowing you to easily hook up press or release of a GuiButton for the action.

@roblox/enum/InputActionType.Direction1D.documentation: The InputAction will receive numerical values, generally from analog gamepad triggers such as KeyCode.ButtonL2 or KeyCode.ButtonR2. This setting also exposes the Up and Down properties on child InputBindings, allowing for boolean inputs or "1D" inputs as composite directions for the action.

@roblox/enum/InputActionType.Direction2D.documentation: The InputAction will receive Vector2 values, generally from thumbstick inputs such as KeyCode.Thumbstick1 and KeyCode.Thumbstick2. This setting also exposes the Up, Down, Left, and Right properties on child InputBindings, allowing for "2D" inputs as composite directions for the action.

@roblox/enum/InputActionType.Direction3D.documentation: The InputAction will receive Vector3 values from inputs assigned to the Up, Down, Left, Right, Forward, and/or Backward properties on child InputBindings, allowing for "3D" inputs as composite directions for the action.

@roblox/enum/InputActionType.ViewportPos.documentation: The InputAction will receive Vector2 values representing the absolute pixel (X, Y) coordinates of a pointer input in the viewport.

@roblox/global/Enum.InputActionType.documentation: This enum is used by InputAction.Type to determine which input data type the InputAction will receive.

@roblox/enum/AnalyticsEconomyFlowType.Si.documentation: Currency is being removed from the player's account.

@roblox/enum/AnalyticsEconomyFlowType.So.documentation: Currency is being added to the player's account.

@roblox/enum/TeleportResult.Failure.documentation: The teleport failed for an unknown reason.

@roblox/enum/TeleportResult.GameNotFound.documentation: The game that this player attempted to teleport to could not be found.

@roblox/enum/TeleportResult.GameEnded.documentation: The game that this player attempted to teleport to has ended.

@roblox/enum/TeleportResult.GameFull.documentation: The game that this player attempted to teleport to is full.

@roblox/enum/TeleportResult.Unauthorized.documentation: The player is not authorized to complete this teleport.

@roblox/enum/TeleportResult.Flooded.documentation: Too many teleport requests have been made recently.

@roblox/enum/TeleportResult.IsTeleportin.documentation: The player is currently being teleported.

@roblox/global/Enum.TeleportResult.documentation: Describes the result of a teleport.

@roblox/enum/RolloutState.Default.documentation: Uses the engine-wide rollout default, which changes as the feature progresses through its rollout phases.

@roblox/enum/RolloutState.Disabled.documentation: Opts out of the feature regardless of the engine-wide rollout phase.

@roblox/enum/RolloutState.Enabled.documentation: Opts in to the feature regardless of the engine-wide rollout phase.

@roblox/global/Enum.RolloutState.documentation: A three-phase rollout state used to opt in or out of engine features.

@roblox/enum/TweenStatus.Canceled.documentation: The tween was cancelled before completion.

@roblox/global/Enum.TweenStatus.documentation: The completion status of a GuiObject tween function.

@roblox/enum/ExperienceEventStatus.Activ.documentation: The event is currently published and available.

@roblox/enum/ExperienceEventStatus.Cance.documentation: The event has been cancelled and will not occur.

@roblox/enum/ExperienceEventStatus.Moder.documentation: The event has been removed by moderation.

@roblox/enum/ExperienceEventStatus.Unpub.documentation: The event has been unpublished by the creator.

@roblox/enum/ExperienceEventStatus.Unkno.documentation: The event status could not be determined.

@roblox/enum/AvatarAssetType.DressSkirtA.documentation: A layered clothing dress or skirt.

@roblox/global/Enum.AvatarAssetType.documentation: Describes the asset types that an avatar can equip.

@roblox/enum/ProximityPromptExclusivity..documentation: One prompt will be shown per input KeyCode.
Only one prompt will be shown with this setting.
This prompt will always show when in range and visible.

@roblox/enum/ModelStreamingMode.Atomic.documentation: The Model and all of its descendants are streamed in/out together. For streaming in, this applies when any descendant BasePart is eligible for streaming in. For streaming out, this applies when all descendant BaseParts are eligible for streaming out.

@roblox/enum/ModelStreamingMode.Persiste.documentation: Persistent models are sent as a complete atomic unit soon after the player joins and before the Workspace.PersistentLoaded event fires. Persistent models and their descendants are never streamed out.

Behaves as a persistent model for players that have been added using Model:AddPersistentPlayer(). For other players, behavior is the same as Atomic. You can revert a model from player persistence via Model:RemovePersistentPlayer().

@roblox/enum/ModelStreamingMode.Nonatomi.documentation: When a nonatomic model is streamed, descendants are also sent, except for part descendants. Nonatomic models that are not descendants of parts are sent during experience loading.

@roblox/global/Enum.ModelStreamingMode.documentation: Controls stream in and out behavior of a model.

@roblox/enum/BundleType.BodyParts.documentation: A bundle of body parts and accessories.

@roblox/enum/BundleType.Shoes.documentation: A bundle of left shoe and right shoe.

@roblox/enum/BundleType.DynamicHead.documentation: A bundle consisting of dynamicHead and moodAnimation assets, optionally with eyebrowAccessory and eyelashAccessory.

@roblox/global/Enum.BundleType.documentation: The type of a bundle of assets.

@roblox/enum/NormalId.Right.documentation: The right face of a Part.
